Hollow Feast (Horrific Flesh Abomination, Boss Encounter)  HP: 50  AC: 14  Attacks (Multiattack, 2 per turn): o Flailing Limbs (1d10 bludgeoning, reach 10ft) o Engulf (Grapple + Con Drain 1d6 per turn, DC 14 escape)  Abilities: o Horrific Wailing: Any living creature within 30ft must make a DC 15 Wisdom Save or become frightened for 1 minute. o Corpse Hunger: When it kills a target, it grows stronger (regains 10 HP). Survival XP Rewards:  Clearing all enemies: +200 SV  Discovering hidden lore in the wine cellar: +100 SV  Escaping without triggering hazards: +50 SV bonus

sites.name: Leaf & Steam
sites.bookText:
Leaf & Steam (Shop #41)
“The warm scent of aged oolong and spiced chai 
lingers in the still air, a ghost of hospitality now lost to 
time. Bamboo furniture, once polished and pristine, is 
now covered in dust and scattered tea leaves. The 
walls are lined with shelves of exotic tins, some still 
sealed, their labels marked with delicate calligraphy. 
A decorative waterfall in the corner trickles weakly, 
clogged with dried herbs and debris. A sign reading 
‘VIP Lounge – Members Only’ hangs over a beaded 
 294 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
curtain leading to the dimly lit back room. Something 
about this place feels strangely… watched.”
General Description
Leaf & Steam was a stylish tea house catering to 
refined palates, offering imported teas, specialty brews, 
and a tranquil escape from the hustle of the mall. The 
shop has two primary areas:
1.
Main Tea Room – An open space with low 
bamboo tables, meditation cushions, and a 
small counter where orders were once taken. A 
single electric kettle still works, plugged into 
an emergency outlet behind the counter.
2.
VIP Lounge – Behind the beaded curtain lies a 
darker, incense-scented space. A hidden door 
in the back wall leads to a storage room.
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & 
Traps (roll 1d4 on entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Boiling Kettle Trap – A 
pressurized tea kettle explodes 
when disturbed (Dex DC 14 to 
avoid, 1d6 fire damage, noise adds 
+1d6 Tension).
2
Loose Bamboo Flooring – 
Certain floorboards creak 
ominously (Stealth DC 12 or alert 
zombies in nearby rooms).
3
Falling Tea Shelf – A top-heavy 
shelf collapses if disturbed (Dex 
DC 13 or take 1d6 bludgeoning, 
50% chance to shatter ceramic 
jars loudly).
4
Tripwire Gong Alarm – A hidden 
tripwire triggers a large hanging 
gong near the entrance (+2d6 
Tension instantly, 50% chance 
to summon 1d4 Shamblers in 
1d4 rounds).
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Luxury Tea Sampler (Tradeable, 
25 SV each) – Pristine tins of rare 
teas still sealed.
2
Ceramic Teapot (Improvised 
Weapon, 1d6 bludgeoning) – 
Heavy enough to knock out a 
zombie or a rival survivor.
3
Ancient Chinese Medicine Scroll 
(Lore Clue, 50 SV to right buyer) 
– Notes on herbal remedies, 
mentions “life restoration” 
experiments.
4
Hidden Stash of Alcohol (15 SV 
each) – Bottles of aged sake and 
whiskey hidden in the storage 
room.
5
Working Tea Kettle – Can be used 
for boiling water (sanitization), 
hot beverage morale boost, or 
scalding attack (1d6 fire, one use 
per session).
6
Handwritten Note (Lore Clue) – A 
note in elegant script: “He told 
us the tea would open our eyes. 
He never said we would see 
them staring back.”
Ambiguous Lore:
Scattered throughout the tea shop are cryptic clues 
hinting at what may have happened in the mall. Roll a 
d4 if the players search for lore:
d4 
Roll
Ambiguous Clue
1
A receipt from “BioDyne Corp.” – 
Lists bulk orders of strange herbs, 
 295 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
including one labeled “Xeno-Infusion 
Sample #7.”
2
A tattered pamphlet from an 
occult group. – Reads: “The Sixth 
Seal breaks not with fire, nor with 
war, but with the slow steeping of 
eternity.”
3
A cracked tea cup with strange 
symbols. – The inscriptions match 
markings found in other locations 
tied to the supernatural.
4
A weathered security memo. – 
Warns employees “Do NOT 
consume the VIP Blend. 
Symptoms include hallucinations 
and involuntary muscle 
movement.”
VIP Lounge & Secret Storage 
Room
Behind the beaded curtain, the VIP Lounge is a dark, 
unsettling space with plush cushions and a strong, 
lingering scent of herbal incense. Survivors who stay 
here too long feel a creeping sensation of unease.
The Storage Room (hidden door, Perception DC 14) 
contains:
- 10 lbs of Loose Tea (Tradeable, 100 SV total)
- Herbal Medical Kit (Heals 1d6 HP, +2 bonus vs 
infection, 50 SV)
- Mummified Corpse – Dressed in tea house robes, 
eyes sunken and blackened. Clutching a shattered 
teacup.
If disturbed, the corpse suddenly exhales a dry 
whisper in an unknown language before collapsing into 
dust.
Enemies & Threats
d6 Roll Enemy Encounter
1-2
Shambler Duo (2x) – Lurking in 
the VIP Lounge, tangled in bead 
curtains.
3
Corpse Drinker – (AC 12, HP 18, 
Bite 1d6 + Infection Chance) A 
bizarre zombie that drains liquid 
from corpses. Can spit acidic tea 
(1d6 acid damage).
4
Infused Tea Ghoul – (AC 14, HP 
22, Claw 1d8) A survivor who 
drank the “special blend.” Moves 
erratically, whispers in multiple 
voices.
5
Tea Cultist Remnant – A skeletal 
figure in tattered robes, still stirring 
a phantom cup. Will chant 
hypnotic phrases (WIS Save DC 
13 or become Stunned for 1 
round).
6
Ambush! (1d4 Runners burst 
through back door) – Recently 
turned baristas, still wearing 
name tags. Fast and feral.
XP & Survival Value (SV)
Action or Loot
SV Reward
Fully clearing Leaf & 
Steam
300 SV

Tins
25 SV each
Discovering the 
Hidden Storage 
Room
+100 SV bonus
Using the Tea Kettle 
for Survival Uses
+50 SV (one-time 
bonus)
Avoiding combat via 
stealth or distraction
+75 SV bonus
Tension Impact
Action
Tension Increase
Triggering Gong 
Alarm
+2d6 Tension
Fighting in VIP 
+1d4 Tension per 
 296 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
Action
Tension Increase
Lounge (enclosed 
space)
round
Disturbing the 
Mummified Corpse
Instant +5 Tension
Using Boiling Kettle 
as a weapon
+1d4 Tension (steam 
screams)
Final Notes & Story Hooks

Survivors may encounter a rival faction 
here scavenging for rare goods.

If the VIP Blend is brewed and consumed, 
players experience brief hallucinations, 
seeing flashes of rituals, alien landscapes, or 
forgotten memories.

The tea tins can be traded with other 
survivors—but who else knows what the VIP 
tea actually does?
Next Event Possibilities:
- A rival survivor claims this shop as their own 
“holy ground” and challenges the party to a tea-duel 
(or a gunfight).
- Returning here later may reveal a new group of 
cultists, re-establishing the tea shop as a place of 
worship.
- Someone over the radio is willing to trade a 
powerful artifact for the right blend of tea… but 
why?

sites.name: Iron Edge Athletics
sites.bookText:
Iron Edge Athletics (Shop 
#42)
“The air inside Iron Edge Athletics is thick with the 
scent  of  stale  sweat  and  rubber.  Weightlifting 
equipment  lies  abandoned,  some  still  loaded  with 
dangerously  heavy  plates.  Treadmills  sit  frozen  in 
mid-run, their screens flickering erratically. A cracked 
mirror reflects the decayed remains of long-forgotten 
gym  rats.  Empty  protein  shake  bottles  and  pre-
workout tubs clutter the reception desk, some of them 
cracked open like scavenged rations. A motivational 
banner still hangs from the ceiling, taunting: ‘PAIN IS 
WEAKNESS LEAVING THE BODY.’ In the flickering 
fluorescent  light,  you  swear  you  see  movement 
between the squat racks.”
General Description
Once a bustling fitness center for bodybuilders and 
health enthusiasts, Iron Edge Athletics is now a grim 
graveyard of abandoned ambitions. Rusting dumbbells, 
overturned weight benches, and shredded resistance 
bands clutter the floors. The smoothie bar is in ruins, 
but a few unopened protein bars and supplements 
remain. Some lockers hang ajar, their contents rifled 
through, while others remain locked, potential treasures 
hidden within.
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & Traps (roll 1d4 on entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Overloaded Weight Bar – A squat 
bar precariously balanced on a 
rack. Any loud movement nearby 
(or a failed Dex check) causes it to 
fall loudly, dealing 2d6 
bludgeoning to anything beneath 
and adding +1d6 Tension.
2
Protein Spill – A spilled tub of pre-
workout makes the floor slick. DC 
13 Dex Save or fall prone, taking 
1d4 damage.
3
Locked Lockers – A row of lockers 
remains locked. DC 14 Strength or 
DC 12 Lockpicking to open. (See 
loot table below.)
4
Treadmill Trap – A 
malfunctioning treadmill 
suddenly activates when stepped 
on. DC 14 Dex Save to avoid 
being thrown into a nearby 
weight rack (1d6 damage, +1d4 
Tension).
Threats & Enemy Encounters 
(roll 1d6 upon entering)
d6 Roll
Enemy Encounter
1-2
Shambler Pack (1d4 zombies) – 
 297 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
Former gym-goers, now 
sluggishly wandering among the 
machines.
3
“Broseidon” The Mutant Lifter 
– A mutated, roided-up zombie 
that never skips leg day. Hits 
harder but moves slower.
4
Protein-Fed Rats (2d6) – 
Aggressive, oversized rodents 
feasting on spilled supplements.
5
Gym Mirror Mimic – A creature 
lurking behind a cracked mirror, 
striking when survivors get close.
6
Silent Stalker – A lone, eerily 
still zombie in a yoga pose… 
until disturbed.
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Unopened Protein Bars (3-6x) – 2 
SV each, minor food value.
2
Pre-Workout Powder (3 Uses) – 
Grants +2 Strength for 1 hour, but 
increases Tension by +1d4 due to 
jitters.
3
Weighted Vest (15 lbs) – Can be 
worn as improvised armor (AC +1, 
but -5ft speed).
4
Rusty Dumbbell (Melee Weapon, 
1d8 Bludgeoning) – Heavy but 
effective in combat.
5
Steroid Vials (2x Uses) – Instantly 
restores 2d8 HP, but causes 1 level 
of Exhaustion after 1 hour.
6
Survivalist’s Gym Bag (Hidden 
Loot, DC 14 to find) – Contains a 
survival knife (1d6 piercing), 
flashlight, and 1-day ration of 
food (Total 50 SV).
Ambiguous Lore
Scattered throughout the gym, players can find 
conflicting clues about what happened in the mall:
d4 Roll Ambiguous Clue
1
A smashed radio is still 
broadcasting distorted words: “…
experiments… bio-enhancement… 
terminated subjects escaped…”
2
A locker note reads: “Guys, you 
feel weird after that new 
supplement? Keep getting 
headaches… see you tomorrow for 
deadlifts.”
3
A graffiti warning scrawled across 
the mirror: “STRONGEST 
SURVIVE. THE REST… ARE 
FUEL.”
4
A blood-stained gym 
membership card labeled 
“BioDyne Performance Program - 
TEST SUBJECT #11.”
Special Encounter: 
“Broseidon” the Mutant Lifter

AC: 15

HP: 40

Attack: Barbell Smash (2d6 bludgeoning) or 
Shoulder Charge (1d8, knocks prone)

Special: Immune to grapple and shoving due 
to sheer muscle mass.

Tactics: Slow but relentless, smashes 
survivors into the gym equipment.
If Broseidon is defeated, his corpse can be looted for: 
- Key to Locker #47 (inside: Tactical Vest, 50 SV) - 
Experimental Performance Enhancer (Grants +2 
Strength permanently, but increases Tension by +2d6 
due to side effects)

Additional Notes

If survivors barricade the entrance, the gym 
can serve as a makeshift training ground. 
Spending 1 full in-game day here allows 
survivors to reroll one Strength or 
Constitution-based check once per session 
due to training.

Survivors may discover an abandoned duffel 
bag containing a gym logbook. It details pre-
apocalypse rumors about an experimental 
supplement trial happening at the mall.

If players leave without fully securing the room, 
rats from the protein spill may infest 
another part of the mall in 1d4 days.
Final Thoughts:
Iron Edge Athletics is a high-risk, high-reward 
location. Survivors can find valuable supplies, but 
they also risk drawing more attention due to heavy 
equipment hazards and loud encounters. The 
mystery of experimental supplements hints at 
corporate malfeasance behind the apocalypse. Whether 
players use the gym for strength training, loot it, or 
just get crushed by a falling barbell, it’s bound to 
leave a lasting impact.

sites.name: Fine Cuts Deli
sites.bookText:
Fine Cuts Deli (Shop #43)
“The air in Fine Cuts Deli is thick with the lingering 
scent of aged spices, dried herbs, and something far 
less pleasant—something coppery, something old. A 
massive, dust-covered butcher block sits in the center 
of the room, stained dark with years of use. Behind 
the  counter,  a  rusting  meat  slicer  stands  like  a 
guillotine, its blade still gleaming under the flickering 
fluorescent  light.  Display  cases,  once  filled  with 
premium cuts, are now streaked with dried blood, 
their glass cracked. The rhythmic drip of something 
unseen echoes from the back storage room, just out 
of  sight.  A  half-eaten  sandwich,  disturbingly  fresh, 
rests on the counter. Someone—or something—has 
been here recently…”
General Description

Layout: Fine Cuts Deli is a mid-sized butcher 
shop and sandwich counter, located near the 
food court. The front is mostly open, with an 
L-shaped counter separating the public area 
from the kitchen and prep zone. A meat locker 
lies in the back, its heavy steel door slightly 
ajar.

Ambiance: The room is eerily still, save for 
the occasional rustle from the back room. 
The overhead lights flicker, creating 
unsettling shadows along the tiled walls. There 
are half-prepared meals on the counters, left 
behind in the middle of prep. Something 
knocked over the spice rack, leaving 
cayenne and paprika dusted across the 
floor like dried blood.
 299 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall

Threats: Something is lurking in the walk-in 
freezer—and it’s not entirely dead.

Hazards: Slippery grease stains, rotting 
meat piles, and loose glass shards from 
shattered display cases make movement 
dangerous.
Environmental Hazards & 
Traps (Roll 1d4 on entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Dripping Meat Locker – A 
rhythmic drip… drip… drip sound 
comes from the walk-in freezer. 
The source? A corpse impaled on 
a meat hook. Opening the door too 
quickly drops the body, requiring a 
Dexterity DC 14 check to avoid 
being entangled (restrained for 
1d4 rounds).
2
Slick Bloodstains – The floor near 
the counter is coated in grease and 
dried blood. Players must 
succeed on a DC 12 Dexterity 
check or slip prone, making them 
vulnerable to surprise attacks.
3
Meat Slicer Deathtrap – The still-
functional meat slicer is rigged as 
a trap by a previous survivor. A 
Dexterity DC 15 check notices the 
hidden wire; failing to spot it results 
in the next person touching the 
counter losing 1d6 HP to an 
instant slicing wound.
4
Rats Nest – A swarm of infected 
rats (1d4) bursts from the 
sandwich bar, biting and 
gnawing at exposed flesh.

5

Can be used for bartering or 
improving food morale.
6

Grapple Check) – Found hanging 
from the freezer ceiling.
Ambiguous Lore Clues
d4 Roll Strange Clue Found
1

shipping manifest showing 
BioDyne Corp ordered “organic 
testing materials” from Fine Cuts 
Deli. Who the hell was running this 
place?

Encounters

sites.name: Perfect Focus
sites.bookText:
Perfect Focus (Shop #44)
“A  shattered  glass  display  crunches  beneath  your 
boots as you step into the dimly lit optical store. Rows 
of dusty eyeglasses sit askew on rusting metal racks, 
their lenses cracked or missing. The faint scent of 
antiseptic and old paper lingers in the air. A broken 
digital  eye-test  machine  flickers  erratically,  casting 
eerie light onto the walls. Half-filled bottles of contact 
lens  solution  sit  like  forgotten  relics  on  the  front 
counter,  their  contents  long  evaporated.  A  lone 
optometry chair, its seat torn and dark-stained, creaks 
softly—as if recently disturbed. And then, from the 
back storage room, you hear the distinct sound of 
something shifting in the dark.”
Description

Layout: A small, narrow store filled with rows 
of eyeglasses, optometry equipment, and 
forgotten prescription slips. The back room is 
cluttered with old appointment records and 
locked cabinets.

Threats: Zombies trapped in the storage room, 
an unsettling humanoid mannequin in the 
corner, and a potential gas leak hazard.

Hazards:
o
Broken Glass (DEX Save DC 13 to 
avoid making noise)
o
Faulty Wiring (If disturbed, 1d6 
electrical shock, +1d4 Tension)
o
Gas Leak (Ignition triggers explosion, 
2d10 fire damage in 10ft radius)
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Prescription Lenses (Rare Find) 
– Can be traded for 30 SV or used 
to repair high-end scopes.
2
Optometrist’s Toolkit – Precision 
tools for lockpicking or fine repairs 
(15 SV, grants +1 on Repair 
checks).
3
Contact Lens Solution – Three 
intact bottles (5 SV each, 
prevents eye infections).
4
Medical Eye Wash Kit – Can treat 
temporary blindness or chemical 
burns (20 SV).
5
Prescription Stimulants – 
Performance-enhancing drug (+1 
DEX or INT for 1 hour, 40 SV).
6
Scratched-Up Welding Goggles 
– Grants eye protection against 
bright flashes and minor debris 
(10 SV).
Hidden Loot:
- Lockbox in Back Room (Locked, DEX DC 15 to 
open) – Contains $500 in cash (useless but tradeable), 
a gold watch (50 SV), and a small revolver with 3 
bullets (35 SV).
 302 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
Ambiguous Lore (Choose 1 
or Roll d4)
d4 Roll Cryptic Clue Found
1
A BioDyne memo about testing 
“neurological inhibitors” on 
human subjects. It mentions 
“unexpected retinal activation.”
2
A medical journal referencing a 
wave of unexplained blindness 
cases before the outbreak. Some 
patients claimed to see “shadow 
figures” before losing their vision.
3
A burnt security report describing 
an employee who went missing 
inside the store—with a note 
saying, “He walked into the dark, 
and we never saw him again.”
4
An eye exam chart defaced with 
cultist writing. The letters spell 
out: “The Watcher is Always 
Watching.”
Environmental Hazards & 
Traps (Roll 1d4 on Entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Flickering Lights – The overhead 
fluorescents suddenly strobe, 
disorienting everyone for one round 
(-2 to all Perception checks).
2
Eye Chart Trap – A hidden motion 
sensor activates a loud alarm 
when someone approaches the 
back room (+2d6 Tension).
3
Shambling Optometrist – A 
partially blind zombie in a torn lab 
coat attacks with a broken eye-
exam device (1d8 bludgeoning, 
+5% infection chance).
4
The Mannequin Moves – A 
human-sized optometry 
mannequin in the corner slowly 
changes position when no one is 
looking. If ignored for too long, it 
suddenly lunges (DEX Save DC 
14 or take 2d6 slashing).
Possible Enemy 
Encounters (Roll 1d6 on 
Entry or Noise Event)
d6 Roll Zombie/Threat Type
1-2
Storage Room Lurkers (1d4 
Shamblers) – Zombies trapped 
behind a jammed door. Loud 
noises may let them out.
3
The Optometrist (Special 
Zombie) – A once-human doctor 
who has no eyes, yet moves 
toward sounds perfectly. Immune 
to blinding effects.
4
Crawler Zombies (1d3) – 
Limbless undead wriggling 
beneath the counter, trying to latch 
onto ankles.
5
Mannequin Horror – If disturbed, 
this humanoid statue animates 
and attacks like a zombie, but 
moves silently.
6
Trapped Survivor – A weakened 
but paranoid NPC hiding in the 
back, armed with a makeshift 
crossbow. May trade, flee, or 
shoot on sight.
Monster Stats
Shamblers (1d4)

HP: 12 each
 303 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall

Attack: Bite (1d6 damage, infection chance)

Speed: Slow-moving (20ft), low perception
The Optometrist (Special 
Zombie)

HP: 20

Attack: Scalpel Stab (1d6, ignores armor)

Special:
o
Blind But Deadly: Immune to 
flashbangs or blinding effects.
o
Sonar Hearing: Detects movement 
even in darkness.
Mannequin Horror

HP: 18

Attack: Unnatural Grip (1d8 crushing damage, 
grapples target)

Special:
o
Only Moves When Not Watched
o
Silent Killer: No noise when moving 
or attacking.
XP & Survival Value (SV) 
Rewards
Action or Loot
SV Reward
Securing Perfect 
Focus completely
250 SV
Finding Prescription 
Stimulants
40 SV
Unlocking and 
looting the Back 
Room Safe
100 SV
Defeating The 
Optometrist
50 SV
Action or Loot
SV Reward
Discovering 
Ambiguous Lore
50 SV
Tension Impact
Action
Tension Increase
Making noise on 
broken glass
+1d4
Activating alarm trap
+2d6
Failing to kill the 
Optometrist quickly
+1d6
Smashing the front 
window (intentionally 
or not)
+3d6
Additional Roleplaying 
Opportunities

Paranoid Survivor (if rolled on d6 table) – If 
approached cautiously, he might trade a scope 
attachment (improves ranged attacks) for 
food or safe passage.

Radio Frequency Anomaly – Tuning a 
working radio in this store reveals a faint, 
repeating distress signal mentioning “The 
Lighthouse is safe.”
Final Thoughts
Perfect Focus is a small but unsettling shop that 
plays with vision, perception, and hidden threats. 
The mix of optical equipment, eerie mannequins, 
and ambiguous lore makes it a memorable encounter 
with both useful loot and a sense of growing 
unease.

sites.name: Trendsetters
sites.bookText:
Trendsetters (Shop #45)
“Rows of mannequins stand motionless, dressed in 
once-trendy outfits now coated in dust. Their glassy, 
lifeless eyes seem to follow your every move. The 
store’s wide floor is littered with broken clothing racks 
and toppled mannequins, some missing limbs, others 
 304 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
arranged in unnatural poses. A half-finished display in 
the corner features a headless figure draped in a 
designer trench coat, its severed head lying on the 
floor as if it had been gnawed off. The air carries a 
faint scent of old perfume and something sickly sweet
—rot just beneath the surface.”
Description:

Layout: A modern clothing boutique, now 
eerily quiet. Tall shelves divide the floor, 
stocked with long-outdated fashions. The store 
is split into three sections: Menswear (left), 
Womenswear (right), and Accessories 
(back). A large dressing room area in the rear 
contains several locked stalls. A broken 
security camera blinks in the corner, still 
powered by some unknown source.

Threats: 1d4+1 Mannequin Zombies (see 
below) disguised among the lifeless 
mannequins. They remain still until approached 
or disturbed.

Hazards:
o
Clothing Racks (Difficult Terrain): 
Moving through the collapsed racks 
reduces movement speed by half.
o
Falling Mannequins: Any loud 
movement (failed Stealth DC 13) 
knocks over a mannequin, increasing 
Tension by +1d4.
o
Locked Dressing Room (DC 15 
Strength/Dex to force open): 
Something is banging from inside…
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & Traps (Roll 1d6 on 
Entry)
d6 Roll Hazard
1
Uncanny Reflection: A full-body 
mirror reflects one extra party 
member—a figure that isn’t really 
there. Causes a rising sense of 
unease but has no mechanical 
effect.
d6 Roll Hazard
2
Security Announcement: A pre-
recorded mall message suddenly 
plays over the store speakers: 
“Trendsetters is having a seasonal 
sale—don’t miss out!” It echoes 
across the mall. (+1d4 Tension, 
attracts zombies within 50 feet.)
3
Hidden Tripwire: A survivor once 
rigged the entrance. Stepping on it 
(Perception DC 14) causes a shelf 
to collapse loudly. (Instantly 
increases Tension by +2d6.)
4
Mannequin Mimicry: A 
“mannequin” at the back slowly 
shifts when players look away. After 
three rounds, it moves closer. It 
isn’t a zombie—just an elaborate 
prank left behind… or is it?
5

Display” (Optional)
At the back of the store, near the locked storage door, 
stands a spotlit mannequin display arranged in a 
macabre tableau. Two mannequins sit at a table, 
“eating” plastic food, another stands behind them, 
“serving,” and a fourth mannequin, missing its lower 
jaw, is seated with its head turned toward the 
entrance. A motion sensor light flickers above.
Interacting with the display triggers the following 
effects (roll 1d4):

players turn away, one mannequin is suddenly 
standing behind them. | 
| 2 | Whispering Voices – A faint, distant laughter 
echoes through the store. No clear source. | 
| 3 | Security Light Flickers – When it stabilizes, one 
mannequin is missing. | 
| 4 | Instant Attack – The jawless mannequin lunges 
at the nearest player (Surprise Round). |

unlocks, revealing a hidden panic room where an old 
skeleton clutches a shotgun. They didn’t make it—but 
their last words are scrawled on the wall in lipstick:
“They weren’t just watching… they were waiting.”

sites.name: Vault of Wonders
sites.bookText:
Vault of Wonders (Shop 
#46)
“The dim glow of emergency lights barely pierces the 
dusty gloom of the Vault of Wonders. Shelves teeter 
with  long-forgotten  collectibles—rows  of  plastic-
wrapped  comic  books,  boxed  action  figures,  and 
trading  cards  sealed  in  glass  cases.  A  lifeless 
Deadpool mannequin leans against the register, its 
frozen smirk twisted in mockery of the apocalypse. A 
faint rustling comes from deeper inside the store—
perhaps just the wind through a broken vent… or 
something  else  moving  among  the  aisles.  The  air 
smells of stale paper and something sickly sweet, like 
old candy left too long in the sun.”
Description:

Layout: A narrow, crowded comic shop where 
towering display racks and glass cases form a 
maze of pop culture relics. Card tables in the 
back suggest this was once a hangout spot for 
trading card game tournaments.

Threats: Something is stalking among the 
aisles. If players linger too long, 1d4 Stalker 
Zombies (stealthy, lurking undead) will attack 
from the shadows.

Hazards: Dusty, collapsing shelves 
(Dexterity DC 13 to avoid falling debris, 1d6 
damage), shattered glass from broken display 
cases (Stealth checks made here have 
disadvantage).
Interactables & Loot:
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Sealed Collector’s Comic (50 SV) 
– A near-mint issue of The 
Amazing Spider-Man #1. If kept 
intact, it’s valuable for trade.
2
Rare Trading Card Deck (25 SV) – 
A full set of “Summoner’s Wrath” 
holofoil cards, possibly tradeable.
3
Replica Katana (35 SV, counts as 
a longsword) – A surprisingly 
sharp movie prop, still in pristine 
condition.
4
Survival Manual Disguised as a 
Comic (Hidden Lore Clue, 20 SV) 
– A bootlegged survival guide 
hidden inside a graphic novel.
5
Cosplay Armor (AC 12, 
Lightweight) – A reinforced 
Batman suit, usable as light armor.
6
Unopened Snack Stash (Food x3, 
15 SV) – An employee’s hidden 
 307 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
cache of old candy bars and 
bottled water.
Ambiguous Lore:
Scattered across the shop are cryptic clues hinting 
at the apocalypse’s origins:
d4 Roll Strange Clue
1
A promotional poster for an 
unreleased movie, Z-Day: Final 
Dawn, dated just weeks before 
the outbreak.
2
A bloody handprint smeared 
across an UmbraTech 
advertisement for “Next-Gen 
Biosecurity Solutions.”
3
A VHS tape labeled “DO NOT 
WATCH” hidden behind a row of 
graphic novels.
4
A bizarrely detailed comic book 
predicting the apocalypse with 
unsettling accuracy—published 
years before it happened.
Tension Impact:

Loud Actions (breaking glass, knocking 
over shelves): +1d4 Tension

Lingering too long (more than 10 minutes 
in-game): +1d6 Tension

Triggering Stalker Zombies: Immediate +1d6 
Tension if they attack
Enemies (1d6 Roll for 
Encounters)
d6 Roll Zombie/Threat Type
1-2
Shamblers (1d4) – Basic slow 
zombies, knocking over shelves as 
they lurch forward.
3
Stalker Zombies (1d4) – Lurk in 
the shadows, only attacking when 
players turn their backs.
4
Crawler Zombie (1) – Hiding 
beneath a pile of comics, waiting to 
grab an ankle.
5
Prop Mannequin Mimic (1) – A 
zombie disguised as a superhero 
mannequin, suddenly lunging at 
players.
6
“The Collector” (Unique NPC 
Survivor) – A lone survivor 
obsessed with trading valuable 
comics for supplies.
Enemy Stat Blocks:
Stalker Zombie (1d4)

AC: 12

HP: 15

Attack: Clawed Ambush (1d6 damage, +1d6 if 
attacking from stealth)

Abilities: Moves silently, can hide as a pile of 
junk until disturbed.
The Collector (Optional NPC Encounter)

HP: 20

Weapon: Makeshift Spear (1d8 damage)

Personality: A former comic shop owner who 
refuses to leave. He will barter comics for 
supplies and warn players of “something 
watching us from the shelves…”

sites.name: Savory Selections
sites.bookText:
Savory Selections (Shop 
#47)
“The air inside Savory Selections is thick with the 
ghostly scent of spices long past their prime. Tall 
wooden  shelves,  once  brimming  with  exotic 
ingredients,  now  stand  half-looted  and  ransacked. 
Broken jars of saffron and turmeric stain the dusty tile 
floors with eerie golden streaks. A display case of 
high-end olive oils has been shattered, leaving the 
ground  dangerously  slick.  In  the  dim  emergency 
lighting, you see scattered cans of unfamiliar foreign 
brands,  labels  peeling  from  moisture  and  time. 
Something  rustles  behind  the  counter,  a  soft  but 
deliberate  sound,  like  someone—or  something—
searching through the wreckage…”
General Description
Savory Selections was once an upscale specialty food 
store, catering to foodies and gourmet chefs with its 
selection of rare spices, imported canned goods, and 
fine oils. Now, it’s a half-plundered wreck, its delicate 
glass jars and bottles shattered across the floor. The 
layout consists of towering shelves (some toppled), a 
cashier’s counter, and a small storage room in the back 
that’s still locked.
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & Traps (roll 1d4 on entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Oil Slick Floor: Moving at full 
speed (without a DEX DC 14 
check) causes a slip, knocking 
prone and making noise (adds 
+1d4 Tension).
2
Toppled Shelves: A precariously 
leaning shelf threatens to collapse 
if disturbed (STR DC 15 to hold up, 
or collapses for 2d6 damage, 
creating loud noise).
3
Rotting Smell: An overturned sack 
of dried fish and cheese emits a 
putrid stench, forcing a CON DC 
13 save vs. nausea (disadvantage 
on Perception for 10 minutes).
4
Hidden Alarm System: The 
store’s security panel still has a 
bit of power; if tampered with, it 
blares a loud beeping noise, 
summoning nearby zombies 
(+2d6 Tension).
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Aged Saffron Stash – A sealed tin 
of saffron (worth 75 SV for trade, or 
 309 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
used to boost morale with a special 
meal).
2
Rare Canned Goods – High-end 
gourmet food (1d6 cans, each worth 
5 SV, still edible).
3
Luxury Cooking Oils – Three 
unbroken bottles of imported olive 
oil (10 SV each, or used for 
makeshift fire traps).
4
Japanese Chef’s Knife – Razor-
sharp (1d6 slashing, finesse 
weapon, 30 SV).
5
Spice Vault Key – A key behind the 
register opens the back storeroom, 
where more preserved food 
supplies (worth 100 SV) are stored.
6
Mystery Can (Unlabeled) – A 
strange can with no markings. If 
eaten, roll 1d4: (1) Exotic Feast 
(boost morale), (2) Mediocre 
Meal, (3) Mild Food Poisoning 
(-1d6 HP), (4) Strange Parasite 
Infection (CON Save DC 14, 
unknown effects in 1d4 days).
Ambiguous Lore Clues (roll 
1d4 when searching the store)
d4 Roll Clue
1
Crimson-Stained Memo – A torn 
note behind the register reading: 
“We saw them eating—changed so 
fast. Stay out of the food court. 
Don’t touch the frozen goods.”
2
BioDyne Supply Order – A 
shipping invoice reveals that 
Savory Selections received a 
private shipment from “BioDyne 
Pharmaceuticals” two weeks before 
the outbreak. The contents are 
labeled “Nutritional Supplement 
34X (Experimental).”
3
Radio Transmission – A forgotten 
walkie-talkie crackles to life with 
static: “…the kitchen staff… it’s 
spreading… DO NOT LET THEM 
GET TO THE WATER SUPPLY…” 
before cutting out.
4
Cultist Symbol Burned into 
Wood – An occult sigil is seared 
into the back of the storage room 
door. It’s a shape that appears in 
other parts of the mall, 
suggesting some deeper ritual 
activity before the collapse.

sites.name: Morsel & More
sites.bookText:
Morsel & More (Shop #48)
“Shelves of garishly colored snack packages line the 
walls, their faded labels promising flavors both exotic 
and bizarre. A toppled display case of novelty sodas 
has spilled its contents across the floor, forming a 
sticky patchwork of dried-up syrup. The air is thick  
with the mixed scents of stale popcorn, artificial fruit, 
and something sickly sweet that you can’t quite place. 
The  neon  ‘TASTE  THE  WORLD’  sign  flickers 
overhead, casting erratic flashes across a half-eaten 
candy bar sitting ominously on the checkout counter. 
A faint rustling comes from the back of the store—
something, or someone, is still here.”
Description

Layout: A small specialty snack shop filled 
with shelves of rare international candies, 
novelty sodas, and obscure junk food. The 
checkout counter is covered in dust and old 
receipts. The back storage room is locked, 
and a freezer full of mystery meat hums 
unnaturally, somehow still running.

Threats: Possible “Preserved” Shamblers 
(1d4), zombies that seem strangely fresh 
despite the decay, as if something in the 
store’s food kept them from rotting normally.

Hazards:
o
Sticky Floor: A patch of dried soda 
near the back makes movement 
difficult (DC 12 DEX check to avoid 
being restrained).
o
Expired Nightmare: If players 
consume any food from here without 
careful inspection (Medicine DC 14), 
roll a d4:
| d4 | Effect |
|—-|——–|
| 1 | Rotten Food! - Violent food 
poisoning (1d4 poison damage per 
hour for 3 hours). |
| 2 | Energizing Snack - Grants 
advantage on next initiative roll. |
| 3 | Tainted Oddity - Strange visions 
or hallucinations (GM discretion). |
| 4 | Unholy Deliciousness - No ill 
effects; this is actually still good! |
o
Mystery Freezer: An old freezer in the 
back emits an unsettling hum. It is 
locked with a heavy-duty chain (STR 
DC 16 or lockpicking DC 15).

up food without a fight, has advantage on first 
attack if defending stash.
Final Notes
Morsel & More can be a goldmine of strange snacks 
that could provide unexpected benefits or hazards, 
adding risk vs. reward. The freezer mystery provides 
additional layers of horror, while the lore clues 
continue to deepen the mystery of the mall’s 
apocalypse.
Do the players take the food for survival? Do they 
investigate the freezer at their own peril? Do they 
encounter something truly unnatural hiding among the 
shelves?
Let them decide.

sites.name: The Book Nook
sites.bookText:
The Book Nook (Shop #49)
“The smell of aged paper lingers in the stale air as 
you step inside. Shelves sag under the weight of 
forgotten tomes, their spines cracked and dust-laden. 
Rows  of  horror  novels,  survival  guides,  and 
conspiracy theory books line the walls, their garish 
covers  promising  the  secrets  to  surviving  an 
apocalypse  that  has  already  happened.  A  toppled 
bookshelf blocks part of the backroom, and scattered 
pages  whisper  across  the  floor  like  discarded 
warnings.  Something  moved  behind  the  counter—
was it a rat… or something worse?”
General Description
Once a cozy independent bookstore, The Book Nook 
is now a dimly lit, claustrophobic maze of knowledge 
and decay. The main shop floor consists of tightly 
packed wooden shelves forming narrow aisles, some of 
which have collapsed. A back storage room lies 
behind a locked door, while an old reading corner with 
armchairs and a broken coffee machine sits near the 
front. The checkout counter is cluttered with 
abandoned notebooks, half-eaten snacks, and a still-
glowing computer monitor blinking with an unsent 
message.
 314 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
Layout Features:

Main Floor – Bookshelves form tight 
pathways, reducing mobility.

Reading Corner – Armchairs, magazines, and 
a non-functional fireplace.

Checkout Counter – Cash register, half-eaten 
snacks, a flickering laptop.

Back Storage Room – Blocked by a collapsed 
shelf, requires STR (DC 14) or DEX (DC 16) to 
squeeze through.
Threats & Hazards
d6 Roll Threat Present
1-2
Shamblers (1d4+1) slowly pacing 
the aisles, their groaning muffled by 
paper-stuffed mouths.
3

between bookshelves (DEX DC 14 
to notice before it lunges).
4
“Survivalist” Zombie – A corpse 
in body armor with a tactical vest 
full of gear, still clutching a survival 
manual.
5
Conspiracy Wall – Notes, red 
string, and maps taped to a board 
in the backroom. Disturbing it 
triggers an alarm bell (Tension 
+1d6).
6
The “Archivist” (Mutant Zombie) 
– A bloated, eyeless zombie that 
secretes black ink-like bile, 
staining everything it touches. Its 
screech draws more undead 
(Tension +2d6).
Hazards & Environmental Traps
- Toppled Shelves – Unstable bookshelves can 
collapse if disturbed (DEX DC 13 to avoid, 1d6 damage, 
loud noise adds +1d4 Tension).
- Ink Slick – Spilled ink and coffee make certain areas 
slippery (DEX DC 12 or fall prone).
- Locked Storage Room – Requires Lockpicking (DC 
15) or brute force (STR DC 17) to open.
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Finds
1
Survival Guide (The Prepper’s 
Bible, +1 to Scavenging Rolls if 
studied for an hour).
2
Cryptid Field Manual (Hints at the 
existence of “otherworldly beings” 
involved in the apocalypse).
3
Old Laptop (Booted up with last 
emails referencing a “containment 
breach at BioDyne Labs”).
4
Hidden Safe (Locked, DEX DC 16 
to open) containing $500 in old 
bills (useless) and a loaded 
revolver (6 rounds).
5
Torn Notebook (Handwritten 
entries about strange figures 
appearing outside the mall before 
the outbreak).
6
Flashlight & Battery Pack (Still 
functional, extends light radius 
for exploration).

Books as Distractions: Throwing a book into 
an area can distract zombies for 1 round.

Books as Barricades: Shelves can be used to 
create makeshift barricades (Improvised 
Defense, AC 12, HP 20).
Ambiguous Lore: 
Conspiracy or Truth?
This store is a goldmine of conflicting information 
about the apocalypse’s origins. The bookshelves and 
walls contain scattered clues, but none of them fully 
align.

sites.name: MediMart
sites.bookText:
MediMart (Shop #50)
“The glass doors to MediMart are shattered, jagged 
shards still clinging to the frame. Inside, sterile white 
tiles  are  smeared  with  old  blood,  leading  chaotic 
paths  toward  overturned  shelves  and  looted  pill 
bottles.  A  lone  fluorescent  light  flickers,  casting 
uneasy shadows over the pharmacy counter. The air 
carries a stale medicinal odor, tinged with the faint 
metallic scent of dried blood. Somewhere in the back, 
something shifts—a soft rustling, just beyond sight. 
The pharmacy wasn’t completely emptied… and it 
wasn’t completely abandoned.”
Description:

Layout: MediMart is a mid-sized pharmacy 
with aisles of empty shelves, a locked 
pharmacy counter, and a staff-only 
backroom. Many over-the-counter medications 
have been taken, but heavier prescriptions 
remain locked away.

Threats:
o
2-5 Lurkers (Crawler Zombies): Low-
mobility undead wedged under 
shelving, waiting for prey.
o
1 Stalker: A partially sentient zombie 
in a lab coat that hides in the storage 
room.

Hazards:
o
Collapsed Shelves: Moving too fast 
through the aisles may knock over a 
shelf, causing a domino effect (Dex 
DC 14 to avoid 1d8 bludgeoning and 
a loud crash that raises Tension by 
1d6).
o
Glass Shards: Moving barefoot or 
carelessly through the entrance inflicts 
1d4 damage per round.
o
Toxic Medicine Cloud: A shattered 
bottle of experimental meds in the 
backroom causes hallucinations 
(WIS Save DC 14) if inhaled.
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
First Aid Kit (20 SV) – Bandages, 
antiseptic, basic wound care.
2
Antibiotics (2 doses) (30 SV) – 
Prevents infection, rare find.
3
Expired Painkillers (4 doses) (10 
SV each) – Reduces pain, but may 
cause side effects.
4
Prescription-Strength Stimulants 
(25 SV) – Grants temporary 
exhaustion resistance.
5
Defibrillator (75 SV, makeshift 
weapon, or medical use) – Can 
shock a zombie for 1d12 electric 
damage but takes 1 round to 
recharge.
6
Lockbox with Narcotics (50 SV, 
requires lockpicking DC 16) – 
Valuable for trade, but potentially 
addictive.
 317 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
Hidden Loot:

Locked Storage Room: Contains trauma kits, 
stronger painkillers, and adrenaline 
injectors (total 100 SV). Door requires 
Lockpick DC 15 or Strength DC 18 to break.

Security Cabinet: A sturdy emergency 
supply case (AC 16, HP 20) with auto-
injectors and a blood transfusion kit (total 
150 SV).
Ambiguous Lore
Scattered throughout MediMart are cryptic clues 
hinting at the mall’s apocalyptic origins. Survivors 
might find:
d4 Roll Ambiguous Clue
1
A burned note behind the 
pharmacy counter, reading: “Do 
NOT let them in. They’re not just 
sick.” Signed J. Henderson, 
Pharmacist.
2
A blood-smeared lab report 
detailing “a viral mutation causing 
uncontrollable aggression and high 
resistance to necrosis.” The 
company name is redacted.
3
A crushed body behind the 
counter, clutching a small 
BioDyne Corp keycard. The dead 
employee’s ID is missing, but 
there’s a thumbprint scanner on 
the pharmacy door.
4
A handwritten prayer note tucked 
into the narcotics lockbox, 
reading: “Forgive me, Lord. The 
Sixth Seal is broken. We are 
already judged.”
XP & Survival Value (SV)
Action
SV Reward
Securing MediMart 
250 SV
Action
SV Reward
(no threats remaining)
Opening the Locked 
Storage Room
100 SV
Looting the Security 
Cabinet
150 SV
Extracting lore 
(reading all clues)
75 SV
Using defibrillator on 
a zombie (comedy 
value)
10 SV
Tension Impact

Breaking into the storage room (door 
smashing or lockpicking failure) +1d4 Tension

Knocking over a shelf (failed Dex check) 
+1d6 Tension

Gunfire inside raises +2d6 Tension due to 
echoes in the enclosed space.

Leaving the defibrillator active (it makes 
noise when charging) +1d4 Tension per 10 
minutes
Potential Enemies
d6 Roll Zombie/Threat Type
1-2
Lurker Zombies (2-5) – Crawlers 
trapped under debris, bite ankles 
(Dex DC 13 to avoid).
3
Pharmacist Stalker – Retains 
fragmented memory, wears a 
BioDyne Corp badge. Ambushes 
survivors looking for meds.
4
Hoarder Survivor (desperate & 
armed) – Willing to negotiate or 
fight for remaining supplies.
5
Aggressive Mutant Patient – 
Looks human but has unusually 
fast regeneration (heals 1 
 318 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
HP/round unless fire or acid 
damage).
6
Spitter Zombie – Vomits acidic 
bile (1d6 ongoing damage, Dex 
DC 14 to avoid).
Monster Stats
Lurker Zombies

HP: 10

AC: 9

Atk: Bite (1d6, infection chance)

Move: 5 ft (prone)

Special: Grapple Attack – If a Lurker bites, 
the target must succeed on a Strength DC 13 
save or be restrained.
Pharmacist Stalker

HP: 22

AC: 12 (lab coat)

Atk: Scalpel (1d6 slashing)

Move: 30 ft (can hide among shelves)

Special: Knows the layout – Moves silently, 
gains advantage on stealth checks.
Aggressive Mutant Patient

HP: 30

AC: 14

Atk: Claw (1d8 slashing)

Move: 40 ft

Special: Regenerates 1 HP per round unless 
fire/acid damage is applied.
Survival Scenarios 
(Optional Events)
If the players stay too long or make too much noise, roll 
a d6 encounter event:
d6 Roll
Random Event
1
Survivor Barges In – A 
starving NPC arrives, 
demanding medicine for 
their sick family. Will the 
players share or turn them 
away?
2
Ambush! – The Lurker 
Zombies under the shelves 
all attack at once, pinning 
someone.
3
Radio Signal Discovered – A 
battery-powered radio crackles: 
“Survivors at the roof… last 
chance… repeat…”
4
Collapsed Ceiling Tile – Dust 
and debris fall, blinding 
characters (CON Save DC 
12).
5
Medical Horror – A twitching 
corpse sits up, eyes black 
and bloodshot, whispering: 
“They told us it was safe…” 
before violently attacking.
6
Chemical Explosion! – A 
leaky oxygen tank near a 
broken Bunsen burner 
ignites! Dex DC 14 or take 
2d8 fire damage.
Final Notes
MediMart is a high-value resource zone, but lingering 
too long increases the risk of higher Tension, 
dangerous mutations, and rival survivors looking for 
the same critical medical supplies. If the players 
extract the pharmacist’s ID badge, they may gain 
access to other BioDyne Corp locations in the mall.

sites.name: Brown Crust Bakery
sites.bookText:
Brown Crust Bakery (Shop 
#51)
“A sickly-sweet stench of stale bread and rot clings to 
the air. Once a cozy neighborhood bakery, the Brown 
Crust Bakery is now a haven for dust, mold, and the 
occasional scurrying rat. The glass display cases are 
shattered, their insides lined with desiccated pastries 
and  flies.  A  half-eaten  loaf  of  sourdough,  now 
fossilized, sits on a rusted tray near the register. The 
large industrial ovens in the back loom like gaping 
maws, and the flour-dusted floor bears eerie drag 
marks leading toward the kitchen. A faint scratching 
echoes  from  within  the  walk-in  freezer,  as  though 
something inside is trying to get out…”
General Description

Layout: A small storefront with a register 
counter, a crumbling pastry display, and a 
menu board still advertising long-forgotten 
deals. The open kitchen in the back has 
industrial ovens, a dough-kneading station, and 
a large walk-in freezer. The rear exit is 
barricaded with stacked flour bags and 
overturned baking trays.

Threats: Something is inside the walk-in 
freezer, but it hasn’t broken out… yet. The 
ceiling has several Hanging Dough Sacks—
one of which conceals a lurking Crawler 
Zombie. The rats here are unusually 
aggressive, their eyes reflecting an unnatural 
red.

Hazards:
o
Flour Dust Explosion Hazard: Any 
open flame (or gunfire) in the kitchen 
could ignite a massive fireball (3d6 
fire damage in a 15ft radius).
o
Moldy Bread Spores: Long-term 
exposure (10+ minutes) requires a 
Constitution check (DC 13) or suffer a 
persistent cough, imposing Stealth 
Disadvantage for 1 hour.
o
Rats’ Nest: Disturbing the pile near 
the back will release a swarm of 
infected rats.
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & 
Traps (Roll 1d4 upon entering 
the bakery)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Flour Cloud Ignition: If disturbed, 
the airborne flour dust becomes 
highly flammable—a single spark 
or open flame (gunfire, lighter, etc.) 
triggers a 3d6 explosion (DEX 
save DC 14 for half).
2
Feral Rat Swarm: Opening a 
cabinet or knocking over supplies 
unleashes 1d4+1 rabid rats that 
attack the party, dealing small but 
persistent bites.
3
Stale Air & Mold Spores: 
Breathing inside the bakery for 
more than 10 minutes requires a 
CON save (DC 13) or suffer 
Stealth Disadvantage due to a 
persistent cough.
4
Lurking Crawler Zombie: One of 
the flour sacks conceals a 
hidden zombie that drops onto 
the first person walking 
underneath (DEX save DC 15 or 
be grappled).
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Flour & Sugar Reserves – Large 
sacks of still-usable flour and sugar 
(total: 50 SV) but heavy.
2
Butcher’s Cleaver – Rusted, but 
still sharp (1d6 slashing, bonus 
against undead flesh).
3
Expired Energy Bars – Found

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
behind the counter; still edible if you 
don’t think too hard about it (10 SV, 
morale boost).
4
Kitchen Blowtorch – Useful for 
repairs, igniting things, or combat 
(1d8 fire, but 1/3 fuel remaining).
5
Hidden Register Cache – A 
survivor stashed a small revolver 
(25 SV) and 6 bullets (10 SV) 
inside an emptied-out cash register.
6
Walk-In Freezer Mystery – Inside 
the freezer lies something frozen 
solid—a survivor who locked 
themselves in and never left…

+1d6 Tension

infection)

swarm disperses.

Final Thoughts

The Brown Crust Bakery is a mix of 
environmental hazards, loot opportunities, 
and an eerie lore tie-in to the mall’s greater 
mystery.

The freezer subplot offers a moment of player 
choice—do they risk opening it? Do they 
ignore the scratching sounds?

The flammable flour hazard adds a layer of 
potentially chaotic consequences if gunfire 
or fire-based attacks are used.

The lore hints provide more ambiguity on 
whether the outbreak was biological, 
supernatural, or something worse…

actions.text: Feral Rat Swarm: Opening a cabinet or knocking over supplies unleashes 1d4+1 rabid rats that attack the party, dealing small but persistent bites.

actions.name: Stale Air & Mold Spores
actions.text: Stale Air & Mold Spores: Breathing inside the bakery for more than 10 minutes requires a CON save (DC 13) or suffer Stealth Disadvantage due to a persistent cough.

actions.name: Lurking Crawler Zombie
actions.text: Lurking Crawler Zombie: One of the flour sacks conceals a hidden zombie that drops onto the first person walking underneath (DEX save DC 15 or be grappled). Interactables & Loot d6 Roll Notable Items

actions.name: Flour & Sugar Reserves
actions.text: Flour & Sugar Reserves – Large sacks of still-usable flour and sugar (total: 50 SV) but heavy.

actions.name: Butcher’s Cleaver
actions.text: Butcher’s Cleaver – Rusted, but still sharp (1d6 slashing, bonus against undead flesh).

actions.name: Expired Energy Bars
actions.text: Expired Energy Bars – Found  behind the counter; still edible if you don’t think too hard about it (10 SV, morale boost).

actions.name: Kitchen Blowtorch
actions.text: Kitchen Blowtorch – Useful for repairs, igniting things, or combat (1d8 fire, but 1/3 fuel remaining).

actions.name: Hidden Register Cache
actions.text: Hidden Register Cache – A survivor stashed a small revolver (25 SV) and 6 bullets (10 SV) inside an emptied-out cash register.

actions.name: Walk-In Freezer Mystery
actions.text: Walk-In Freezer Mystery – Inside the freezer lies something frozen solid—a survivor who locked themselves in and never left… Ambiguous Lore (Roll 1d4 for Clues) d4 Roll Cryptic Clue Found in the Bakery

actions.name: Bloodstained Note wedged under the counter
actions.text: Bloodstained Note wedged under the counter: “They told us not to bake the special order… but we did. Now we all pay the price.”

actions.name: Newspaper Clipping on the Wall
actions.text: Newspaper Clipping on the Wall – Features a BioDyne scientist being awarded a grant for “revolutionary food preservation techniques.”

actions.name: Faint Symbols Scratched into the Freezer Door

actions.name: Security Camera (Still Working?)
actions.text: Security Camera (Still Working?) – An old security monitor shows looping footage of the bakery, but sometimes, the footage changes when no one is looking. Crawler Zombie (Hidden in Dough Sack)  HP: 14  AC: 10  Attacks: Bite (1d6, infection chance) / Grab (opposed STR roll to escape)  Special: If grappled, it clamps onto a limb, requiring an action to pry off. actions.name: Frozen Corpse (Harmless)
actions.text: Frozen Corpse (Harmless) – A long-dead survivor, clutching a bloody journal with frantic, illegible writing.

actions.name: Revenant Zombie
actions.text: Revenant Zombie – A survivor who froze just before turning… and is now thawing. (Stats as Brute Zombie, but moves sluggishly at first.)

actions.name: Strange Meat
actions.text: Strange Meat – Large slabs of heavily mutated flesh, possibly human, with faint movement inside. (Eating it has consequences.)

actions.name: Locked from the Inside?
actions.text: Locked from the Inside? – Someone is still in there, alive, banging weakly on the door… but do you want to let them out? XP & Reward Summary Action XP / SV Gained Securing the Brown Crust Bakery 100 SV Finding a working food supply stash +50 SV Safely recovering weapons/tools (Revolver, Blowtorch, Cleaver) +50 SV Solving the Freezer Mystery +100 SV Not triggering an explosion (Smart +25 SV Action XP / SV Gained play) Final Thoughts  The Brown Crust Bakery is a mix of environmental hazards, loot opportunities, and an eerie lore tie-in to the mall’s greater mystery.  The freezer subplot offers a moment of player choice—do they risk opening it? Do they ignore the scratching sounds?  The flammable flour hazard adds a layer of potentially chaotic consequences if gunfire or fire-based attacks are used.  The lore hints provide more ambiguity on whether the outbreak was biological, supernatural, or something worse…

sites.name: Big Bite Burger
sites.bookText:
Big Bite Burger (Store #52)
“The scent of rancid grease lingers in the stagnant 
air, mingling with the stench of decay. A broken soda 
machine dribbles a syrupy mix onto the tiled floor, 
sticky  and  black  with  age.  The  mascot  statue—a 
grotesque,  oversized  clown-chef—looms  in  the 
corner, its fiberglass face defaced with crude graffiti. 
‘FEAST  FOREVER,’  someone  scrawled  across  its 
chest in red paint—or something worse. A row of 
fryers stand in eerie silence, their contents long rotted 
away,  and  a  busted  cash  register  sits  atop  the 
counter  like  a  forgotten  relic  of  civilization. 
Somewhere in the back kitchen, something drips at 
an irregular rhythm, like a slow, heavy heartbeat.”
Description

Layout:
A standard fast food joint with a counter up 
front, a dining area with overturned tables and 
booths, and a back kitchen filled with grimy, 
rusted equipment. The drive-thru window is 
broken, and a back storage room remains 
locked.

Threats:
o
1d4 Grease Zombies (Shamblers 
 322 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
covered in a flammable, sticky film of 
old fryer oil)
o
1 Manager Husk (A bloated corpse in 
a tattered uniform, still clutching a 
clipboard, stronger than normal 
zombies)
o
Mascot Statue Trap (May animate 
under the right conditions)

Hazards:
o
Slippery Floor: Old grease makes 
movement treacherous. Any sudden 
movement requires a DC 13 Dexterity 
save or fall prone.
o
Gas Leak: A faint smell of gas lingers. 
Any fire-based attack has a 25% 
chance to ignite a mall-wide 
explosion (causing 6d6 fire damage 
within 30 feet).
o
Mascot’s Curse? Survivors may feel 
watched by the statue. It’s just 
paranoia… right?
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Big Bite Kitchen Knife (1d6, 
serrated, +1 to Intimidation 
checks) found wedged in a table.
2
Industrial Oil Canister 
(flammable, can be used for traps 
or molotovs, 25 SV) in the back 
kitchen.
3
Moldy Employee Handbook 
containing notes about a strange 
corporate experiment—the pages 
are stuck together with old ketchup.
4
Rusty Cash Register still holding 
1d20x5 SV worth of loose 
change.
5
Employee Locker Key (Unlocks a 
storage room with old uniforms, a 
forgotten pistol (15 SV), and stale 
snack food).
6
Drive-Thru Radio Still Works—
might be able to contact 
someone… or something.
Ambiguous Lore
Scattered clues hint at strange occurrences before the 
mall’s collapse. Each clue is deliberately contradictory, 
deepening the mystery:
d4 Roll
Lore Clue
1
A rotted meal receipt dated 
weeks after the mall was 
abandoned, signed only “Enjoy the 
Feast - Management.”
2
An old training tape in a locked 
office. If played, it describes “The 
Ritual of Eternal Consumption” 
in unsettling detail.
3
A corporate memo about 
“Testing a new flavor enhancer” 
that seems to induce aggressive 
behavior in test subjects.
4
A cultist pamphlet tucked into 
an employee locker: “All must 
eat. All must be eaten. The 
Great Feast approaches.”
Tension Impact

Loud Noises (Cash Register, Fryer Crash): 
+1d4 Tension

Igniting Gas Leak (Catastrophic Explosion): 
+2d6 Tension

Mascot Statue Moving (or appearing to 
move): +1d6 Tension

Attempting to Speak Over the Drive-Thru 
Radio: ???
Potential Enemies
d6 Roll Zombie Type
 323 

Lower Level
 
Zombie Mall
1-2
Grease Zombies (1d4) – Slow, 
covered in flammable old fryer oil.
3-4
The Manager Husk – A bloated 
corpse in a filthy uniform, 
surprisingly strong.
5
Mascot Statue (???) – Did it just 
move? Maybe it’s the light… right?
6
Cursed Big Bite Employee – An 
undead worker still wearing their 
uniform, whispering “Order 
up…” before attacking.
Enemy Stat Blocks
Grease Zombies (1d4)

HP: 14 each

AC: 10

Attack: Slam (1d6 damage)

Special: Covered in old fryer grease—fire-
based attacks deal double damage but ignite 
the area (causing hazards).

Movement: Slower than usual due to 
congealed fat.
Manager Husk

HP: 25

AC: 12

Attack: Clipboard Slam (1d8 damage)

Special: Takes half damage from 
bludgeoning due to bloated body mass.

Lair Action: Can scream in frustration (fries 
sticking together, employees being late), 
summoning 1d4 additional zombies from 
nearby areas.
Mascot Statue (???)

HP: ???

AC: 15 (fiberglass body)

Special: If players remain in Big Bite Burger for 
more than 10 minutes, they may hear the 
statue shuffling slightly when no one is looking 
at it.

If provoked, roll 1d6:
o
1-3: It was just paranoia. The statue is 
still.
o
4-5: The statue has moved slightly, 
facing a different direction.
o
6: The statue attacks, grabbing a 
survivor and attempting to force-feed 
them rancid food (1d10 damage, 
disease save required).
XP & Survival Value (SV)
Action or Loot
SV Reward

threats)

Loose Cash (1d20x5 
SV)

15 SV
Discovering the 
Employee Handbook

+50 SV

Mystery of the

+100 SV (if survived)
Random Events (Roll 1d6 
Every 10 Minutes)
d6 Roll
Random Occurrence
1
The soda fountain gurgles to 
life briefly, spilling thick, red liquid 
instead of cola.
 324 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
2
A cold whisper echoes through 
the drive-thru speaker: “Would 
you like to upgrade to eternal 
hunger?”
3
A zombie in an employee 
uniform shambles out of the 
freezer, still clutching a tray.
4
The fryers start bubbling as if 
they’ve been turned on—despite 
no power running in the mall.
5
A child’s voice is heard 
laughing, but no child is present.
6
The Big Bite Mascot is now 
standing in a different location. 
No one saw it move.
Final Encounter Option: 
“FEAST FOREVER”

If the players linger too long in Big Bite 
Burger, something happens.

Roll 1d20 + total Tension score:
o
10 or lower: They escape without 
issue.
o
11-15: A zombie employee bursts out 
of the freezer.
o
16-19: The drive-thru radio 
screeches, summoning 2d6 zombies 
from elsewhere in the mall.
o
20+: The Mascot Statue lunges, 
attempting to consume one unlucky 
survivor whole.
Final Notes
Big Bite Burger is more than just a looted fast-food joint
—it’s a creeping, psychological horror encounter. The 
food chain’s corporate slogans still linger on the walls, 
promising “A Meal You’ll Never Forget.” And in this 
place, that’s not a choice.

sites.name: Maker’s Market
sites.bookText:
Maker’s Market (Shop #53)
“The  once-cozy  craft  shop  is  now  a  wreck  of 
overturned shelves, shattered ceramics, and bolts of 
fabric tangled in eerie, colorless drapery. A massive, 
half-finished wooden sculpture looms in the center 
like an abandoned totem, its surface pockmarked with 
deep gouges. The sickly-sweet scent of dried paint 
and  rotting  glue  lingers  in  the  air,  mingling  with 
something far more foul. The flickering mall lights cast 
shifting  shadows  over  a  display  of  faceless 
mannequins  dressed  in  handwoven  scarves,  their 
stillness  unsettling.  Something  rustles  in  the 
backroom, but whether it’s wind through broken glass
—or something else—is uncertain…”
Description

Layout:
o
Narrow aisles packed with shelves of 
forgotten crafts, scattered sewing 
kits, knitting supplies, and broken 
pottery.
o
The checkout counter has a register 
rusted shut and a glass display case, 
now smashed.
o
A half-finished wooden sculpture in 
the center (an abandoned project?) 
stands ominously.
o
A back storage room is half-
collapsed, with an ajar door, leading 
into unknown darkness.

Threats:
o
2d4 Shamblers (tangled in fabric, 
difficult to detect at first).
o
1 Stalker Zombie (hiding inside the 
wooden sculpture, waiting to lunge 
at someone inspecting it).

Hazards:
o
Loose Bead Trap: If a player moves 
too quickly, they may scatter beads 
across the floor. (DEX Save DC 14 
or slip prone.)
o
Needle Piles: Hidden among fabric 
scraps are loose needles and 
 325

Zombie Mall
scissors. (Stepping into them causes 
1 HP damage and infection risk.)

be repurposed as makeshift



Survival Challenges
(Optional Events While Exploring Maker’s Market)
d6 Roll Event
1
A survivor’s body is tangled in 
yarn. Their journal tells of 
something watching from the ceiling 
beams.
2
A cluster of mannequins 
suddenly topples over. Was it the 
wind… or something else?
3
A sewing machine begins 
whirring on its own. (Random 
supernatural occurrence or old 
electrical glitch?)
4
A thick tapestry covers a hidden 
passage. Where does it lead?
5
A half-finished marionette has a 
moving mouth. Whispering voices 
come from inside…
6
A masked figure is seen at the far 
end of the shop. When 
approached, they are gone.
 327

Final Thoughts
Maker’s Market is an excellent “slow horror” 
encounter location, blending uncanny aesthetics, 
bizarre lore clues, and unsettling threats. It allows 
for puzzle-solving, stealth, and full-blown terror 
depending on how deep players investigate.

Does the shop hold remnants of a cultist 
ritual?

Did BioDyne experiment with living resin

sites.name: Modern Living
sites.bookText:
Modern Living (Shop #54)
“The  remains  of  a  high-end  furniture  store  stretch 
before  you,  a  graveyard  of  overturned  leather 
couches, broken glass coffee tables, and designer 
armchairs now covered in layers of dust. A massive 
showroom mirror is cracked, distorting your reflection 
in a way that makes your stomach turn. Somewhere 
deeper inside, something shifts—was it just a toppled 
chair settling, or something else moving in the dim 
light? The scent of stale upholstery mingles with a 
faint trace of something metallic… something wrong.”
General Description
Modern Living was once a showroom of luxury furniture 
and home décor, its glossy catalog displays meant to 
entice wealthy shoppers. Now, the store is in shambles
—displays toppled, fabric torn, wooden dining sets 
splintered. A large showroom mirror near the back 
reflects odd shapes in the dimness, and motion sensor 
lights flicker as if they are still clinging to life.
A faint, rhythmic thumping can be heard coming from 
the storage area in the back. It’s slow… deliberate.
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & Traps (roll 1d4 on entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Shatter Trap: The massive 
cracked showroom mirror 
collapses if disturbed (Dex Save 
DC 14 or take 2d6 piercing 
damage, loud noise adds +2d6 
Tension).
2
Unstable Display Shelves: Heavy 
furniture pieces stacked 
precariously. Any sudden 
movement or combat can trigger a 
collapse (Dex Save DC 12 or be 
pinned for 1 round).
3
Hollow Wall Panel: A false wall 
conceals a hidden stockroom with 
valuable supplies—but also 
contains something lurking 
inside (see enemy table).
4
Showroom Lights Flicker On: 
Power briefly surges, activating 
a stereo system playing eerie, 
distorted music. Instantly adds 
+1d4 Tension and attracts 
nearby threats.
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Luxury Survival Gear: High-end 
camping cot (20 SV) and ultra-light 
blanket (5 SV) made for comfort.
2
Hidden Safe: Behind a broken 
dresser—locked (Dex DC 16 to 
pick, STR DC 18 to force). Contains 
cash (worthless), jewelry (Trade 
Value 100 SV), and a loaded .357 
Magnum (Gun, 40 SV, 6 rounds 
15 SV).
3
Glass Coffee Table (Improvised 
Weapon): Heavy but deadly in a 
pinch. Can be used as a makeshift 
shield (+1 AC, shatters after 3 hits) 
or shattered to create caltraps in 
an area (1d4 piercing if stepped 
on).
 328 

Zombie Mall
 
Lower Level
d6 Roll Notable Items
4

bartering (50 SV) or as a Molotov 
Cocktail (if paired with fabric & 
lighter).
5

back storage area, where a 
trapped survivor or more sinister 
horrors may await.
6
Faux Leather Recliner (Booby-
Trapped): Someone has rigged it 
with a spring-loaded knife—
(Perception DC 15 to notice, 
otherwise Dex DC 14 or take 1d8 
slashing). Inside the chair: a 
hidden lockbox with antibiotics 
(30 SV) and a map of the mall 
(plot hook).
Ambiguous Lore
Scattered throughout the store are strange signs and 
messages hinting at the mall’s mysterious apocalypse 
origins:
d4 Roll Ambiguous Clue
1
Employee Note: “Night crew, stop 
locking the mirror stockroom. It 
freaks people out, and we lost a 
guy last week trying to get in. 
Management won’t say why.”
2
Flickering TV Display: The store’s 
showroom TVs occasionally flicker 
to life, displaying static-filled 
security footage of the mall—
sometimes showing things that 
shouldn’t be there.
3
Bloodied Handprint on a Sofa 
Tag: Scrawled in dried blood: 
“They see through the glass. 
Don’t let them out.”
4
Luxury Recliner Still Reclining 
on its Own: No power source is 
connected. The mechanical 
whirring noise is unsettlingly 
human in its breath-like rhythm.
Potential Enemy Encounters 
(Roll 1d6 or pick a threat)
d6 Roll Zombie/Threat Type
1-2

among the furniture, half-crushed 
under fallen shelves.
3

showroom mirror is broken, a 
spectral, distorted reflection of 
the players steps out (HP 20, AC 
15, attacks mimic the players’ 
weapons).
4
Hollow One – A mutilated 
survivor, still alive but gagged 
and bound in the backroom, 
carved with cultist symbols. If 
freed, they may offer disturbing 
insight into the apocalypse—or 
attack suddenly if their 
“masters” demand it.
5
Glass Jaw Brute – A grotesquely 
mutated zombie whose face is a 
jagged mass of glass shards (AC 
14, HP 35, Claw 1d8+2, Bites 
cause bleeding wounds that deal 
1 damage per round).
6
Mannequin Horror – One of the 
showroom mannequins isn’t a 
mannequin. It watches when not 
observed, creeping closer when 
backs are turned. (HP 25, AC 16, 
Claw 1d6, moves only when 
unseen.)

sites.name: Once More With Feeling
sites.bookText:
Once More With Feeling
As you step through the half-open shutters into Once 
More With Feeling, you’re immediately met with a 
stale  smell—a  blend  of  mothballs,  forgotten 
perfumes, and decaying fabric. The store is dimly lit 
by  emergency  lighting  that  flickers  intermittently, 
casting eerie shadows across mismatched clothing 
racks  packed  tightly  with  garments  from  decades 
past. Shelves filled with outdated electronics, chipped 
ceramic figures, and faded photographs hint at the 
lives once attached to these forgotten objects.
Mannequins  wearing  tattered  vintage  outfits  stand 
motionless,  some  toppled  over  or  positioned  in 
strange poses, as though frozen mid-action. A rusted 
antique bicycle leans against an overflowing bin of old 
stuffed  animals,  their  button  eyes  staring  emptily. 
Behind the cracked cashier’s counter, a dusty cash 
register sits open, revealing scattered bills and coins 
that no longer hold any value. The unsettling silence 
is punctuated only by the occasional drip of water 
from a leaking pipe and the distant, muffled groans of 
the undead wandering elsewhere in the mall.
Once More With Feeling 
(Upper-Level Thrift Store)
Room Description:

Layout & Key Features:
o
Once More With Feeling is located 
on the upper level, nestled between a 
darkened corridor and an abandoned 
clothing boutique.
o
Rows of clothing racks create narrow 
pathways ideal for ambushes or 
stealthy maneuvers. The aisles are 
cluttered with piles of clothes, boxes of 
discarded VHS tapes, and small 
stacks of paperback novels.
o
The far end of the store contains a 
fitting-room area with three curtained 
stalls. One stall’s curtain is stained 
dark, with something unsettlingly 
human-shaped behind it.

Creatures/Zombies Present:
o
2x Fashionista Zombies (Runner-
type zombies) – These zombies 
move swiftly and silently, using their 
surroundings to launch ambushes. 
They attack with rusted scissors (1d6 
slashing damage) and will actively 
hide in racks of clothing, blending in 
with the mannequins.
o
1x Shambler Zombie – Behind the 
fitting room curtain, a standard slow 
zombie waits, groaning softly.

Hazards, Puzzles, or Traps:
o
Broken Glass – The entrance and 
various points on the floor are covered 
with broken glass from a fallen mirror. 
Players moving through without 
caution risk creating noise (DC 12 
DEX save to avoid; failure alerts 
zombies and adds +5 to Tension).
o
Weak Flooring – In the back 
storeroom, the wooden flooring is 
damaged (Investigation DC 14 to 
spot). A character stepping on the 
weakened area (DC 13 DEX save) 
may fall into a hidden basement level 
filled with 1d4 shambling zombies.

Interactable Objects:
o
Old Cash Register: Contains a small 
stash of antique coins (potential barter 
or lore item).
o
Fitting Rooms: Concealed cache 
behind one mirror (Perception DC 15 
to notice) holds some painkillers and 
bandages.
o
Antique Bicycle: Rusted but 
repairable, usable as quiet 
transportation or distraction tool.
Dungeon Master Notes: - Have Fashionista zombies 
coordinate ambush tactics, using their stealth to attack 
isolated players. Their sudden speed contrasts sharply 
with typical slow zombies, creating tension. - The 
basement trap is optional but adds complexity and 
danger if players are careless. Use it to introduce secret 
lower-level areas of the mall for future exploration. - The 
stuffed animals can provide a disturbing yet comical 
atmosphere—players might decide to use them as 
distractions or fire starters. - Encourage exploration by 
embedding subtle hints about life before the apocalypse 
through vintage items (photos, journals hidden in 
clothing pockets, etc.).
XP & Survival Value (SV) Rewards: - Total Potential 
SV: 118 SV - Food & Water: None - Medicine:
- Painkillers (x2 packs): 10 SV
- Bandages (x3): 6 SV - Weapons & Ammo:
- Rusty Scissors (improvised melee weapon): 2 SV 
each (x2) - Tools & Materials:
 333 

Upper Level
 
Zombie Mall

Miscellaneous Supplies:
- Antique Coins (barter/trade value): 20 SV
- Assorted Vintage Clothing (for warmth, disguise, or 
barter): 20 SV each full set (up to 3 sets total)
Threat Level & Tension Impact: - Entering and 
engaging loudly (breaking glass, firing weapons) raises 
mall Tension by +5 to +10. - Falling through the 
weakened flooring into basement significantly increases 
Tension by +15 as the noise echoes through lower mall 
areas.
Treasure & Valuable Items: - Weapons: Rusty

silent transport) - Lore Items: Antique Coins, Journal

sites.name: Wanderlust Getaways
sites.bookText:
Wanderlust Getaways sits on the upper level of the 
mall, near a once-busy central escalator. The glass 
storefront is cracked, and scattered brochures litter the 
floor. Brightly colored, faded posters featuring tropical 
beaches, snowy mountains, and iconic landmarks line 
the walls. Several desks are overturned, paperwork 
scattered across the floor amidst toppled computer 
monitors and tangled telephone cords. A reception desk 
with a shattered monitor sits prominently at the 
entrance.
Environmental Conditions:

Dim lighting, flickering occasionally from 
damaged ceiling lights.

Glass shards covering sections of the floor 
(stealth disadvantage).

Half-open door to a small back office.
Hazards, Puzzles, or 
Traps:

Alarm System Trap: Stepping into the back 
office triggers an old security alarm (Perception 
DC 15 to spot motion sensors, Electronics DC 
15 to disable). If triggered, adds +5 Tension.

Collapsing Ceiling Tile: Moving hastily 
through the room might cause a ceiling tile to 
fall (DEX save DC 12 or take 1d4 bludgeoning 
damage and attract nearby zombies).

overturned furniture, they become active if 
disturbed.

office, triggered by alarm or loud noise.

water (x2).

sites.name: Little Sprouts
sites.bookText:
Little Sprouts
“You step cautiously into Little Sprouts, a children’s 
clothing  store  that  once  dazzled  young  eyes  with 
vibrant,  cheerful  displays  now  dulled  by  dust  and 
neglect. Small, smiling mannequins stand frozen in 
playful  poses,  their  joyful  expressions  grotesquely 
juxtaposed  against  the  eerie  silence.  A  toppled 
carousel lies still in the center, its faded unicorns and 
dragons staring blankly into emptiness. Racks of tiny 
clothes  sit  untouched,  gathering  cobwebs,  while  a 
low, haunting lullaby crackles faintly from an unseen 
speaker.”
Room Description: Little Sprouts was once a bright 
haven for young parents, filled with colorful clothes, 
toys, and whimsical decorations. Now, it’s eerie and 
shadowed, its playful innocence warped into something 
unsettling. Scattered toys litter the ground, creating 
tripping hazards and potential improvised distractions.
Environmental Hazards: - Haunted Carousel: 
Occasionally activates spontaneously, making noise 
and increasing tension. - Broken Glass: Near 
shattered display windows; stepping carelessly risks 
injury and noise.

sites.name: Focus Point Optical Shop
sites.bookText:
Focus Point Optical 
Shop
 “A flickering neon sign reading Focus Point sputters 
weakly above the shattered glass entryway, casting 
eerie reflections across rows of designer frames. The 
store’s pristine interior, once sleek and professional, 
now lies in chaotic disarray. Broken glass crunches 
underfoot,  and  delicate  displays  of  expensive 
eyewear sit forgotten beside scattered patient records 
and unclaimed prescriptions. At the rear, a shadowy 
figure in a stained lab coat moves jerkily, rhythmically 
arranging  and  rearranging  frames  on  a  shelf, 
muttering softly to itself…”
Room Details
Lighting: Flickering overhead fluorescent bulbs, 
intermittent darkness.
Soundscape: Occasional distant moans; soft buzzing 
from fluorescent lights.
Smell: Antiseptic mixed with stale air and decay.
Encounter Details
Primary Threat:
- Dr. Lyle Hartley (Optometrist Turned Zombie) 
(unique encounter)
- Additional threats: 1d4 Shambler Zombies lingering 
near the exam room.
Layout

Front Display Area: Scattered glasses, minor 
loot.

Exam Room: Blood-smeared optometry chair, 
medical instruments, higher zombie 
concentration.

Storage Closet: Locked room (medium 
difficulty lockpick) with valuable loot and clues.

(Unique Zombie)

sites.name: Charcuterie & Co.
sites.bookText:
Charcuterie & Co.
Once  an  upscale  delicatessen  renowned  for  its 
artisanal cheeses, cured meats, and exotic olives, 
Charcuterie & Co. has devolved into a place of rot, 
decay,  and  eerie  silence.  Glass  display  cases, 
shattered or cracked, ooze an unidentifiable sludge 
across the marble floors. The pungent odor of spoiled 
meats and sour cheeses permeates the air. Maggots 
wriggle  through  the  cracked  rind  of  forgotten  Brie 
wheels, and flies drone lazily around carcasses of 
dried sausage now blackened and foul.
Despite the decay, useful goods remain hidden, and a 
few areas may still be salvageable, including the walk-in 
freezer—if the generator can be restarted in time.
Hazards: - 
Slippery Floors: Grease and mold-covered floors 
impose disadvantage on Dexterity checks. - 
Spoiled Meat Spores: Constitution save (DC 14) 
required or contract minor infection causing sickness for 
1d4 days. - 
Trapped Freezer: The walk-in freezer’s door may jam 
closed, locking characters inside (DC 15 STR to break 
out or DC 15 INT to repair the mechanism from within).
Random Encounters (d6):
| Roll | Encounter | 
| 1 | 1d4 Shamblers feasting noisily on rotting salami. | 
| 2 | 1 Bloater wedged behind the deli counter, ready to 
burst. | 
| 3 | A group of Cultist Cannibals trying to summon 
something terrible using rotten meats. | 
| 4 | Two Karen Screamers lurking near the cashier 
area. | 
| 5 | Infestation of infected rats (1d8 small infected 
rodents). | |
 6 | No immediate encounter, but loud creaking 
suggests zombies approaching outside. |
Interactables/Loot: - 
Aged Cleaver: 1d8 melee damage, reliable and sturdy. 
- 
Chef’s Knives Set: Sharpened knives (1d6 damage, 
precise and throwable). - 
Walk-In Freezer Supplies: If operational, contains 
frozen meat (1d6 days of edible food, expires 3 days 
after thawing, worth 15 SV each), plus two frozen 
antibiotic kits (25 SV each). - 
Spoiled Meats (Trap Opportunity): Can be used to 
craft zombie bait or traps (5 SV per successful trap). - 
Gourmet Salt: High-quality salt usable for food 
preservation and trade (5 SV per jar, 1d6 jars 
available).
Ambiguous Lore (d4): | Roll | Hidden Lore Clue | 
 1 | Cult Pamphlet: “The flesh is immortal,” hints about 
occult rituals being conducted in the food court 
 339 

Upper Level
 
Zombie Mall
basement. | 
| 2 | BioDyne Corporation Shipping Manifest: Lists 
“special meats” delivered to the labs beneath the mall, 
indicating secret experiments. | 
| 3 | Bloody Note: “We fed them the meats—now the 
Elder Ones rise!” scrawled hastily on butcher paper. | 
| 4 | Cryptic Pamphlet: Religious propaganda detailing 
the Rapture and marking this deli as a “sacred feast 
site.” | 
Hazards & Puzzles:
- The Meat Locker Puzzle:
Characters might find the freezer locked with a numeric 
keypad (DC 14 INT/Electronics check or DC 16 
DEX/Lockpick to open). Incorrect attempts activate an 
alarm (raises mall Tension by +5).

Electrical Panel:
A damaged circuit breaker near the freezer 
controls. Repairing it (DC 14 INT/Mechanical 
Repair) restores temporary power, allowing 
access to supplies but risks electric shock (DC 
13 DEX save or take 1d6 lightning damage).
XP & Survival Value (SV): - Total Available SV: 
Approximately 175 SV - Frozen Meat (usable): 60 SV 
total
- Antibiotic Kits: 50 SV total
- Gourmet Salt Jars: 30 SV total
- Cleaver & Knives: 20 SV total
- Craftable Zombie Traps: 15 SV total
Tension Impact: - Combat Noise: +10 Tension per 
loud combat encounter
- Alarm Triggered (Freezer Lock Puzzle): +5 Tension
- Successful Repair of Freezer Power: Temporarily 
lowers Tension by -5 (morale boost)
Creature Stat Blocks:
Cultist Cannibals (x3)
- AC: 12
- HD: 2 (10 HP each)
- #At: 1 (cleaver/knife)
- Dam: 1d6 melee
- Mv: 30ft
- Special: Ritual chanting attracts 1d4 Shamblers every 
3 rounds.
Bloater Zombie (x1)
- AC: 10
- HD: 4 (20 HP)
- #At: 1 (slam or bite)
- Dam: 1d6+1 melee
- Mv: 20ft
- Special: Upon death explodes (10ft radius, DC 13 
DEX save or contract infection).
Karen Screamer (x2)
- AC: 11
- HD: 3 (15 HP each)
- #At: 1 (claw or bite)
- Dam: 1d4 melee
- Mv: 30ft
- Special: Sonic scream alerts nearby zombies 
(summons 1d6 Shamblers).
Infected Rats (1d8 swarm)
- AC: 12
- HD: 1 (5 HP per rat)
- #At: 1 (bite)
- Dam: 1d2 + possible infection (DC 12 CON save)
- Mv: 30ft, can fit through small spaces easily.

sites.name: 20/20 Vision
sites.bookText:
20/20 Vision
A  sleek  eyewear  store,  now  littered  with  broken 
lenses and abandoned optometry tools.
The elegant glass storefront of 20/20 Vision has 
shattered inward, leaving scattered shards across the 
black-and-white tiled floor. Designer frames, once 
neatly displayed, now lie bent and twisted atop 
overturned shelves and dusty countertops. Optometry 
chairs sit vacant, and diagnostic machines flicker 
occasionally with erratic sparks—ghostly reminders of 
lost normalcy. Shattered mirrors line the walls, reflecting 
distorted images of lurking horrors. A heavy curtain, 
partially torn down, conceals a darkened examination 
room in the back, from which faint noises occasionally 
emerge.
Description & Atmosphere 
(GM Notes):

Visibility:
Dimly lit by a flickering fluorescent panel 
overhead; low visibility and shifting shadows.

Sounds & Smells:
The floor crunches underfoot from glass and 
debris. There’s an antiseptic scent of sterilizing 
alcohol and an underlying odor of decay 
emanating from the examination room.
