sites.name: Sunset Inn Motel
sites.bookText:
Sunset Inn Motel
“The Sunset Inn Motel looms in eerie silence, its neon 
sign flickering erratically—sometimes illuminating the 
cracked  pavement,  sometimes  plunging  everything 
into  shadow.  The  once-inviting  office  now  has 
shattered windows and a broken vending machine 
spilling old candy onto the floor. The air smells of 
mildew, gasoline, and something worse. Several of 
the room doors are boarded up, while others stand 
ominously ajar, their darkness inviting questions you 
may  not  want  answered.  A  TV  inside  one  of  the 
rooms crackles with static, powered by something 
unseen. The muffled sounds of movement echo from 
within, but whether they belong to the living or the  
dead is unclear…”
General Description
The Sunset Inn Motel is a two-story roadside motel 
with a U-shaped layout, its parking lot littered with 
abandoned cars, luggage, and broken furniture. 
Some doors are barricaded, others show signs of 
forced entry, and at least one room is actively 
burning, sending up a thick plume of acrid smoke.
The motel office remains intact but shows signs of past 
desperate survivors looting the cash register and 
minibar. The back alley leads to the motel’s 
maintenance shed, which still has a working 
generator—but something has been feeding on the 
gasoline…
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & 
Traps (roll 1d6 on entry)
d6 Roll Hazard
1
Booby-Trapped Door: A tripwire 
on Room 7 activates a shotgun 
shell rig (2d8 damage, Dex save 
DC 14 to avoid).
2
Floor Collapse: A room’s floor is 
rotting and unstable. Anyone 
stepping inside must roll Dex DC 
12 or fall into a hidden crawlspace 
filled with zombies.
3
“Safe Room” Isn’t Safe: Room 12 
has “SAFE” scrawled on the door. 
Inside, a survivor-turned-zombie 
lies motionless under a blanket, 
waiting to strike.
4
Fire Hazard: Room 5 is actively 
burning. Entering without 
protection deals 1d6 fire damage 
per round, but inside is a well-
stocked first aid kit.
5
Gasoline Trap: The motel’s back 
shed is rigged to explode if 
opened incorrectly. Intelligence 
(Investigation) DC 14 reveals the 
tripwire.
6
Static TV Signal: One room has a 
TV playing distorted emergency 
broadcasts, but the faces on the 
screen seem to watch the 
players… interacting with it 
 165 

Exterior Areas
 
Zombie Mall
raises Tension by +1d6 but may 
give valuable lore clues.
Interactables & Loot
d6 
Roll
Notable Items
1
Motel Keyring (Office): Unlocks 
multiple rooms without force (15 SV).
2
Working Flashlight (Room 3): Extra 
visibility in dark areas (10 SV).
3
Duffle Bag of Stolen Meds (Room 
7): Contains 3 doses of painkillers, 
1 antibiotic bottle (50 SV total).
4
Sawed-Off Shotgun (Hidden in 
Room 9): (2d6 damage, 2-shot 
capacity, 30 SV).
5
Mysterious Survivor’s Journal 
(Office Safe, DC 15 to Open): Hints 
at what happened in the mall before 
the outbreak (Lore Item, 100 SV).
6
Gas Canister (Back Shed, Rigged 
Trap): Usable for generators, fire 
traps, or vehicle refueling (75 SV).
Ambiguous Lore
Throughout the motel, players may find strange clues 
hinting at the larger mystery behind the apocalypse. 
Each contradicts the others, deepening the 
uncertainty:
d4 
Roll
Ambiguous Clue
1
Bloodied pages from a BioDyne 
Corp report, referencing “Test 
Subjects” escaping containment.
2
A hand-scrawled Bible verse: “The 
Sixth Seal was broken. The time of 
judgment has come.”
3
A cryptic note in the office safe: 
“They whisper beneath the static. The 
Mall is the key.”
4
A motel guestbook with pages 
ripped out—except for one, which 
simply reads: “They’re in the 
walls.”

2d10 Tension, but may create an escape 
diversion.

3
Trapped Survivor (Turns in 1 
Round) – A dying human who 
suddenly turns into a Runner 
Zombie (fast & deadly).
4
Burning Zombie (1-2 from 
Room 5) – Engulfed in flames, 
takes 1d6 fire damage per 
turn but doesn’t stop.
5
Crawler Zombies (Hiding 
Under Beds, 1d4) – Limbless 
zombies ambush from below.
6
Motel Manager (Advanced 
Zombie, Room 14) – “Still at 
his post,” stronger and 
retains a semblance of 
memory.
Monster Stats
Shamblers (1d6)

HP: 12

Attack: Bite (1d6 damage, infection chance)

Speed: Slow
Runner Zombie (1)

HP: 15

Attack: Claw Swipe (1d6+2)

Speed: Fast (can take Dash action as a bonus 
action)
Burning Zombie (1-2)

HP: 20

Attack: Grasping Flame (1d8 fire)

Effect: Deals 1d6 fire damage per turn to 
itself, but ignites targets on hit
Motel Manager (Boss-Level)
HP: 30
Attack: Rusty Cleaver (1d8+2) or Grab & Bite (2d6, 
infection chance)
Special: Knows the motel layout, can lock/unlock 
doors remotely (seemingly at random).
Survival XP

Securing the entire motel: 300 SV

Clearing all threats: +100 SV bonus

Finding the secret journal: +100 SV bonus

Negotiating with any trapped survivors (if 
possible): +150 SV bonus

Escaping the Motel without alerting 
zombies: Bonus XP for stealth approach
Final Notes

The Sunset Inn Motel is a high-risk, high-
reward location. Players can find valuable 
supplies, but unpredictable dangers lurk 
behind every door.

The “Motel Manager” zombie adds an eerie 
touch, hinting that some undead retain 
fragments of their former selves.

The static TV & cryptic guest notes deepen 
the mystery—just how many disasters 
happened at once?

Burning the motel down could be a last-
resort option, drawing zombies away from the 
mall but permanently losing potential 
supplies.

sites.name: Trailer Park
sites.bookText:
Trailer Park (Behind Mall)
“Beyond  the  cracked  pavement  and  rusted-out 
dumpsters,  the  trailer  park  lies  in  eerie  silence,  a 
forgotten graveyard of mobile homes slumped in on 
themselves like broken ribs. The smell of mildew and 
rot lingers in the damp air. A few overturned lawn 
chairs and old barbecue grills suggest a time when 
this place bustled with life, but now, only wind rattles 
the  rusted  aluminum  siding.  Somewhere,  a  radio 
crackles  weakly,  spitting  bursts  of  static  and  half-
heard  whispers  that  might  just  be  the  wind…  or 
 167 

Exterior Areas
 
Zombie Mall
something else.”
Description

Layout: A small trailer park, formerly home to 
mall employees and drifters, now a deathtrap 
of collapsed structures, blocked doorways, 
and debris-strewn pathways. A narrow dirt 
road loops around the park, leading toward a 
rusted chain-link fence at the back—partially 
crushed, making for a possible escape route.

Threats:
o
Shamblers (1d4+2)—lurking inside 
trailers, emerging when disturbed.
o
Crawlers (1d3)—half-crushed undead 
dragging themselves under broken 
decks and old cars.
o
Unknown Survivor?—Radio 
suggests someone might still be 
here…

Hazards:
o
Rotten Flooring – Weak wooden 
steps and trailer interiors may collapse 
under weight (DC 12 Dexterity check 
to avoid falling into crawl spaces).
o
Tangled Electrical Wires – Live wires 
dangle from an overturned trailer; 
touching them causes 1d6 electric 
shock and alerts zombies.
o
Blocked Paths – Overturned cars and 
old furniture block easy movement.
Environmental Hazards & 
Traps (Roll 1d6 on Entry)

6

contradicting clues about the apocalypse’s origins:

sites.name: PharmCo Drugstore
sites.bookText:
PharmCo Drugstore 💊
“Glass  crunches  underfoot  as  you  step  inside  the 
ruined  drugstore.  Fluorescent  lights  flicker 
intermittently, casting stark shadows over aisles of 
overturned  pill  bottles  and  broken  shelves.  A 
chemical stench lingers in the air, mingling with the 
unmistakable metallic scent of blood. The pharmacy 
counter in the back has been hastily barricaded, its 
security window smeared with old, dried handprints. A 
few shopping carts lie abandoned, one still filled with 
medical supplies—was someone trying to make a run 
for  it?  Faint  scratching  noises  echo  from  the 
stockroom beyond the broken ‘Employees Only’ door, 
but  it’s  unclear  whether  it’s  rats…  or  something 
worse.”
General Description

Layout: Aisles filled with scattered medicine 
bottles, an overturned shelving unit blocking 
part of the space, a broken pharmacy counter 
at the back.

Threats: Likely hostiles—either zombies 
trapped inside or something worse.

Hazards: Dark corners and obstructed paths 
make maneuvering risky.
 170 

Zombie Mall
 
Exterior Areas
Environmental Hazards & 
Traps (Roll 1d4 when entering 
for additional obstacles)
d4 
Roll
Hazard
1
Leaking Chemical Spill: A puddle of 
caustic liquid from a broken cleaning 
supply shelf burns on contact (1d4 
acid damage if stepped in).
2
Alarmed Pharmacy Counter: If the 
players tamper with the locked 
cabinets, a security alarm briefly 
activates, drawing 1d4 zombies in 
1d6 minutes.
3
Falling Shelf: A partially collapsed 
aisle falls when disturbed. (DEX Save 
DC 14 or take 2d6 bludgeoning 
damage and become pinned.)
4
Infected Cooler: A shattered 
refrigeration unit still contains a 
rotting body. If opened or 
disturbed, 1d4 gasbag zombies 
burst out, releasing toxic fumes 
(CON Save DC 12 or take 1d6 
poison damage and disadvantage 
on rolls for 1 hour).
Interactables & Loot

1

prevent zombie infection (Medical

2

Substitute) – Can be used for 
makeshift molotovs (5 SV each).
4

advantage on STR and DEX 
saves for 1 minute, but causes 
exhaustion after use. (Rare, 50 
SV).
5

(Untouched) – Contains $150 in 
small bills (useless unless a 
faction values it).
6
Prescription Pad & Doctor’s

medical credentials, possibly 
useful in negotiations. (40 SV if 
used cleverly.)
Ambiguous Lore:

BioDyne Pharmaceuticals Letter: A memo 
found in the pharmacy’s locked office 
discusses a “special order of experimental 
medication” for a private client.

Cultist Graffiti on the Back Wall: The phrase 
“The Great Awakening Needs No Cures” is 
written in smeared blood.

Security Camera Footage (If Powered On): 
Looped video of panicked employees 
rushing into the back room, followed by the 
screen cutting to static.

Military Evac Notice (Dated Weeks Before 
Outbreak): A poster warns civilians to 
“proceed to the quarantine zone 
immediately”, signed by Containment 
Protocol Zulu.

Enemies & Stat Blocks
Stockroom Horror (Unique Enemy)

AC: 13

DC 14 to escape)


ceilings.


reduced to 0 HP, the Stockroom Horror does 
not die immediately. It reanimates in 1d4 
rounds unless destroyed by fire or a 
headshot (called shot DC 16).
(This was once a trapped pharmacist. Their body has 
mutated into something barely recognizable.)








AC: 10




poison damage, CON Save DC 12 to avoid 
additional effect.)
Survival XP Breakdown



Clearing threats completely: +50 SV

Discovering the Stockroom Horror’s past 
(lore-based rewards): +100 SV

Recovering Medical Supplies: Varies per 
item
Special Encounter 
(Optional)
“The Last Pharmacist” (Survivor or Corpse) - A 
locked break room behind the pharmacy counter 
contains either:
- A lone survivor (frail, starving, paranoid).
- A dead body with a recorded message (old phone 
playing a final transmission).
If alive, the pharmacist refuses to leave and may: -

sites.name: Gun & Pawn
sites.bookText:
Gun & Pawn Shop 🔫
“The pawn shop’s iron security gate is half-shattered, 
bent  inward  like  something—or  someone—tried  to 
force its way inside. Bullet casings litter the sidewalk, 
mingling with dried bloodstains smeared across the 
display window. Inside, rows of locked glass cases 
hold tarnished jewelry, dusty electronics, and—most 
enticing of all—firearms. A caged-off section at the 
back of the store holds rifles and ammunition, but the 
reinforced  counter  window  is  smeared  with  claw 
marks. A faint ticking noise echoes from somewhere 
deeper  inside  the  shop,  barely  audible  over  the 
occasional creak of settling debris.”
Description

Layout: A cramped interior filled with display 
cases, metal shelves, and a reinforced back 
room where firearms are stored. The 
checkout counter has bullet holes and blood 
smears, and several glass cases have been 
smashed open.

Threats:
•
1d4+1 Shamblers inside, drawn in through a 
broken side window.
•
A Ravenous Ghoul (fast-moving zombie) is 
trapped inside the gun cage, its moans muffled.
•
Survivor Corpse slumped near the register—
wearing a makeshift explosive vest rigged with 
a dead man’s switch.

Hazards:
o
Trapped Gun Cage: The back room is 
reinforced, but any tampering with 
the lock (DC 16) risks triggering an 
old alarm (+2d6 Tension).
o
Dead Man’s Switch: If the body is 
moved carelessly, a rigged pipe 
bomb will detonate (6d6 damage in 
10ft, half on DC 14 Dex save).
o
Unstable Shelving: A loud collapse 
risk if survivors move recklessly or 
fight inside.

sites.name: First National Bank
sites.bookText:
First National Bank 🏦
“The bank’s glass doors hang wide open, their hinges 
twisted and shattered from either desperate looters or 
something far worse. The air inside is thick with the 
stale  scent  of  old  money  and  decay.  A  flickering 
security monitor behind the teller counters plays an 
endlessly  looping  message:  ‘Security  breach 
detected. Please remain calm. Authorities have been 
notified.’ But no authorities are coming. At the far end 
of the main lobby, the vault door gapes open just 
enough for a person to squeeze through—its thick 
metal  marred  by  deep,  jagged  claw  marks. 
Something got inside. But did it ever leave?”
Description:
Layout: A large main lobby, with teller booths, 
abandoned desks, and an eerie silence broken only by 
the occasional hum of flickering lights. The vault, 
slightly ajar, leads to a darkened backroom where 
safety deposit boxes lay ransacked.
Threats:
o
1d4 Shamblers near the teller booths, 
trapped behind counters but still 
reaching hungrily.
o
1d2 Crawlers under desks, waiting to 
ambush anyone searching drawers.
o
Vault Horror (Unique Monster)—
unknown status (only triggers if 
players open the vault further).
Hazards:
o
Motion Sensor Alarm: If the power is 
restored, stepping near the teller 
windows may set off an automated 
security alarm (increasing Tension by 
+3d6).
o
Fallen Ceiling Tiles: Certain areas 
require a Dexterity DC 13 check to 
avoid tripping over debris.
o
Locked Cash Cages: Heavy steel 
bars block access to some areas—
forced entry required (Strength DC 
16 or lockpicking DC 14).
Loot & Interactables:
d6 
Roll
Notable Items
1
Abandoned Handgun (25 SV) – A 
revolver left under a security desk, 
loaded with 3 bullets (10 SV each).
2
Stack of Old Documents – Useless 
paperwork, except one envelope 
marked “BioDyne Confidential” 
(Lore clue).
3
Survival Cash – $3,000 in mixed bills 
(essentially useless, but tradeable 
for 25 SV total).
4
Safety Deposit Box (Locked, DC 15 
to pick) – Contains a gold 
wristwatch (50 SV) and a small vial 
labeled “Specimen X” (Lore clue).
5
Security Baton (1d6 melee weapon, 
15 SV) – Found near a fallen guard.
6
Bank Manager’s Keycard – Allows 
access to restricted areas 
elsewhere in the mall (potentially 
valuable for future encounters).
Ambiguous Lore:
d4 Roll Clue Found
1
A torn military order referencing 
“Containment Protocol Zulu” and a 
 175 

Exterior Areas
 
Zombie Mall
list of high-priority evacuation 
targets.
2
Security Footage (still playing on 
loop) – Grainy black-and-white 
footage of something inhuman 
forcing its way into the vault… but 
the tape glitches before revealing 
what.
3
Handwritten note found near the 
vault, scrawled in panic: “We 
thought it was just a robbery… Then 
the walls started moving.”
4
Old radio transmission from an 
emergency broadcast: “This is 
not a financial collapse… This is 
a biological event. If you can hear 
this, do not trust the banks.”



not entirely human anymore—a former bank robber, 
now twisted beyond recognition.


AC: 14

HP: 40


knocks prone)

obstacles and broken furniture


bank, but if players try to escape mid-
fight, it disappears into the vault’s 
shadows… only to return later in a 
different form.

claw attack forces a Constitution 
Save DC 14 or the victim contracts 
an unknown infection (effects 
determined later by the GM).

(Optional Encounters)
d6 
Roll
Random Event

A lone survivor emerges – A 
ragged man has been hiding behind

starving and delirious—he can 
either help, betray, or flee.

moments, the security cameras and 
alarms briefly turn back on, making 
noise and potentially alerting 
 176 

Zombie Mall
 
Exterior Areas
zombies outside.

minutes.

resources) may unlock more dangers—or 
opportunities.

sites.name: The Gutter Ball Bowling Alley
sites.bookText:
The Gutter Ball Bowling 
Alley 🎳
“The  neon  glow  of  old  beer  signs  flickers  eerily, 
casting  long,  wavering  shadows  over  the  scuffed 
wooden lanes. The air is thick with the musty scent of 
old sweat, stale popcorn, and something far worse—
rotting flesh. A half-eaten body slumps against the 
ball return, its hands still gripping a cracked bowling 
ball.  Overhead,  the  archaic  score  monitors  still 
display the last game played, frozen forever at the 
ninth  frame.  The  arcade  in  the  corner  hums  with 
dying electricity, the screens of old machines pulsing 
erratically like a heartbeat. Then—out of nowhere—a 
solitary bowling pin clatters to the ground, echoing 
through the silence…”
General Description
The Gutter Ball was once a family-friendly bowling 
alley, complete with an attached arcade, snack bar, 
and party room. Now, it has become a festering, 
blood-soaked trap. The lanes are warped and stained, 
several balls are stuck mid-return, and something is 
moving behind the snack counter…

Layout: A large 12-lane bowling alley with a 
snack bar, arcade, back storage rooms, and 
party rental area. The front doors are 
shattered, but the emergency exit remains 
locked from the inside.

Threats: Shamblers stagger among the lanes, 
attracted to sudden movements and noise. A 
lurking bio-mutant hides in the arcade, 
watching from the flickering shadows.

Hazards:
o
Slick Floors: Any fast movement 
(dashing, combat) on the oiled lanes 
requires a DEX DC 12 check or 
causes a fall (prone).
o
Unstable Light Fixtures: A few 
hanging light fixtures sway ominously. 
A well-aimed shot (AC 15) can bring 
one crashing down, dealing 2d6 
bludgeoning damage.
o
Ball Return Jam: A trapped zombie 
hand occasionally flails out from the 
return chute, grasping blindly. Any 
investigation of the ball return risks 
an unexpected grapple attempt 
(STR DC 14 to escape).
 177 

Exterior Areas
 
Zombie Mall
Loot & Interactables
General Loot Table (1d6)
Roll
Item Found
1
Bowling Alley Keycard – Opens a 
security door in the back.
2
Employee First Aid Kit – Contains 
bandages (+10 SV), antibiotics (+20 
SV).
3
Cracked Revolver (Needs Repair) 
– Found under the counter (30 SV, 
but unreliable).
4
Case of Old Beer (6 Bottles) – 
Restores morale, but may attract 
trouble (20 SV).
5
Arcade Prize Counter Loot – 
Cheap trinkets and a stash of small 
batteries (15 SV).
6
Bowling Shoes & Work Gloves – 
Can be repurposed as light gear 
(5 SV).
Hidden Stash (INT or WIS DC 
14)

A maintenance locker in the back contains:
o
A blunt weapon (Bowling Pin Club, 
1d8 damage, silent weapon)
o
Toolkit (15 SV)
o
Flashlight with extra batteries (5-
hour charge, 10 SV)
Ambiguous Lore Clues
Scattered throughout the bowling alley are disturbing 
hints about the origins of the apocalypse—each one 
conflicting with another:
d4 Roll Strange Clue Found
1
Bloody Fingerprints on the 
scoreboard spell out: “They walked 
in from the storm.”
2
A shredded BioDyne security 
badge is lodged in the ball return—
did one of their scientists hide here?
3
A torn cult pamphlet in the arcade 
declares: “Rejoice! The Awakening 
is at hand!”
4
A radio still playing static 
occasionally bursts into a 
garbled voice: “…experiment 
37…containment breach…run…”
Tension Impact

Loud Noises: Any gunfire or shouting 
increases Tension by +1d4.

Triggering the Ball Return (accidentally or on 
purpose) causes a loud mechanical THUNK 
that instantly attracts 1d6 zombies from 
nearby areas.

Arcade Power Surge: Messing with the 
arcade machines may cause a surge, 
resulting in an electrical explosion (DEX save 
DC 13, 2d6 damage, +1d6 Tension 
increase).
Enemies & Threats
Shamblers (1d4+2)

AC: 8

HP: 12 each

Attacks: Bite (1d6, infection on failed CON 
save)

Special: Move slowly, but attack en masse if 
alerted.
The “Perfect Game” Mutant 
(Boss)

AC: 14
 178 

Zombie Mall
 
Exterior Areas

HP: 35

Attacks:
Throw Bowling Ball (2d6 blunt, +1d4 knockback on 
failed STR save DC 14)
Lunge & Crush (1d8, grapples on hit, STR DC 15 to 
escape)

Special Ability: Regen (5 HP per round 
unless fire or electricity is used)

Description:
o
This thing used to be human. Now, 
its arms have fused with two 
bowling balls, making it dangerously 
strong.
o
It lurks in the arcade, illuminated by 
flashing neon lights.
XP & Survival Value (SV)
Action
XP/SV Earned
Clearing out all 
threats
300 SV
Securing the bowling 
alley as a safe zone
500 SV
Finding the hidden 
stash
50 SV
Retrieving the 
Bowling Alley 
Keycard
20 SV
Killing the Perfect 
Game Mutant
200 SV
Discovering at least 
two lore clues
+100 SV bonus
Optional Encounter: The 
League Champion (NPC)

A deranged survivor, once a bowling league 
champion, is hiding behind the counter.

He refuses to leave unless players beat him 
in a game (Skill Challenge: STR or DEX rolls 
to bowl a high score).

If won over, he offers knowledge about the 
mall’s backrooms. If angered, he attacks with 
a razor-sharp bowling shoe (1d6 slashing 
damage, improvised weapon).

Skate Park 
(Exterior) 🛹
“The cracked concrete ramps and rails of the skate 
park  are  littered  with  broken  skateboards  and 
discarded  sneakers.  Graffiti  sprawls  across  every 
surface, some of it typical street art, but much of it 
something… different. Twisting symbols, red-stained 
spirals, and eerie slogans like ‘THE GRIND NEVER 
ENDS’ and ‘WHEELS OF FLESH’ mark the walls. In 
the drained pool at the center of the park, a makeshift 
ritual circle has been drawn in what looks like blood, 
with  a  pile  of  shattered  helmets  and  kneepads 
stacked in its middle. The wind howls through the 
chain-link fence, but there’s another sound—a low 
murmuring,  almost  like  chanting,  coming  from 
somewhere unseen…”
General Description

Layout: The skate park is a large open-air 
structure next to the mall, enclosed by a tall 
chain-link fence with holes large enough to 
squeeze through. It features:
o
A drained pool used for skating, now 
repurposed as a bizarre ritual site.
o
Half-pipes and ramps, providing 
cover and high ground.
o
A small locked maintenance shed, 
possibly containing useful tools.
o
Graffiti-covered walls, some with 
unsettling and unfamiliar symbols.

Threats:
o
1d6 Cultist Stalkers (Stealthy 
scavengers still lurking in the area).
 179 

Exterior Areas
 
Zombie Mall
o
Ritual-Spawned Zombies (1d4, 
emerge from the pool if disturbed).

Hazards:
o
Skate Hazards: Debris makes the 
area difficult terrain unless carefully 
navigated (Dexterity DC 12 to avoid 
tripping).
o
Ritual Zone: Entering the drained 
pool without caution triggers an 
undead ambush.
o
Corrupted Symbols: Staring at the 
graffiti for too long (Wisdom DC 14) 
causes unease, hallucinations, or 
visions of something watching.
Encounter Elements

approached (Zombie ambush).
3

exudes a presence; standing too long 
near it causes vertigo and nausea 
(Constitution DC 13 or take 
disadvantage on next skill check).

empty park. It seems to come from 
every direction at once…

keep turning…”

missing their owners. There are 
no bones. Just… ash.
4

somewhere beneath the mall…

Cultist Stalkers (1d6)
Maddened skater punks turned cultists, lurking in the 
shadows of the skate park.
HP: 14
AC: 12
Speed: 40 ft (Fast on foot, +5ft in the skate park)
Attack:

infection)
o

Special: Skater Reflexes – Cultists can ignore difficult 
terrain in the skate park.
Ritual-Spawned Zombies (1d4)
These creatures are slightly… wrong, infused with 
something beyond normal infection.

HP: 18

AC: 11

Attack: Bite (1d6, DC 12 Con Save or gain a 
lingering sense of being watched)


attack, players hear strange voices 
repeating their names.
o
Unstable Movement – Instead of 
walking, these zombies glide eerily, 
as if on invisible wheels.
Final Thoughts & Optional 
Encounters
The Skate Park offers a high-risk, high-reward 
encounter space, blending urban survival with creepy 
cult influences.

If players investigate further, they may 
uncover a deeper cult conspiracy beneath 
the mall.

If they leave the park unchecked, the cultists 
 181 

Exterior Areas
 
Zombie Mall
might return later, performing another ritual—
possibly inside the mall itself.

If players use the skateboards or ramps, they 
gain speed mobility but risk attracting 
attention.
Bonus Event (Optional) – THE 
SKATER MESSIAH
If players return to the skate park after a major tension 
event (like a mall-wide alarm going off), they find a lone 
robed figure performing sick tricks in the drained pool, 
leaving behind a glowing, rotating sigil on the 
concrete.

Approaching him causes time to distort 
slightly—players experience déjà vu, as if 
they’ve already had this conversation.

If engaged, he speaks in riddles about the 
nature of the apocalypse, mentioning “the loop” 
and “the wheels within wheels.”

His face is missing. Just smooth, empty skin.
If attacked, he vanishes, leaving only the sound of 
unseen wheels rolling away into the night…

sites.name: Main Road
sites.bookText:
Main Road (Mall Entrance)
“The road leading to the mall was once a bustling hub 
of  commerce,  packed  with  holiday  shoppers  and 
impatient honking. Now, it’s a graveyard of rusting 
vehicles and shattered glass, the scent of gasoline 
and  rot  thick  in  the  air.  A  massive  semi-truck, 
jackknifed across the lanes, blocks the main exit—its 
trailer  doors  hanging  open  like  a  gaping  wound. 
Something moves inside. Corpses in business attire 
slump against car doors, some still strapped into their 
seats, others fused with their airbags in grotesque 
embraces. The wind carries the distant groan of the 
undead, but the echoes make it impossible to tell if 
they are near… or closing in.”
Description:

Layout: Wide, open street choked with 
abandoned cars, some piled into wrecks. The 
semi-truck blocks most of the road, forcing 
detours. Several cars have busted doors, 
shattered windshields, or luggage spilled 
into the street.

Threats: High zombie density. Random 
zombies trapped inside vehicles may 
suddenly stir. Some crawl under wreckage, 
waiting for vibrations to signal fresh prey.

Hazards:
o
Tight spaces & blocked paths: 
Vehicles limit movement.
o
Car Alarms: Any impact has a 20% 
chance of triggering an alarm (+1d4 
Tension).
o
Gas Leaks: Damaged cars still drip 
flammable fuel—potential fire hazard 
or explosive opportunity.
o
Jackknifed Semi: Its trailer is open, 
but something is shifting inside…
Interactables/Loot (Roll 1d6 
per scavenger search):
d6 
Roll
Notable Loot
SV Value
1
Survivor’s Backpack 
(Contains bottled water, 
energy bar, and pocket 
knife)
20 SV
2
Pistol (Handgun, 5 
bullets left), found in 
glovebox
50 SV
3
Emergency Road Flare 
(Can distract zombies or 
start fires)
15 SV
4
Trunk Full of Non-
Perishables (Canned 
food, sealed snacks)
75 SV
5
Gas Canister (Half-
Full) – Can be used for 
fuel
30 SV
6
Glovebox Map of the 
Mall – Markings on it 
Lore Clue
 182 

Zombie Mall
 
Exterior Areas
hint at a survivor 
stash somewhere 
inside
Additional Finds:
- Loose scavenging supplies: Plastic water bottles, 
expired snacks, scattered tools (5-10 SV per find).
- Blood-Stained Diaries & Notes: Personal accounts 
of mall survivors with cryptic warnings about what 
happened inside.
Ambiguous Lore:
Evidence of multiple possible causes of the apocalypse 
litter the street, each conflicting with the last…
d6 
Roll
Lore Clue
1
A BioDyne ID badge found near a 
bloodstained security pass—what 
was a pharmaceutical researcher 
doing here?
2
Spray-painted Cultist Symbols on 
an abandoned car—“THE SEVENTH 
SEAL IS BROKEN.”
3
A dead soldier’s radio still faintly 
plays a static-filled broadcast: “This is 
Outpost Delta… protocol collapse… 
avoid urban centers.”
4
Scorched Ground with melted 
asphalt—as if something unnatural 
burned through it.
5
Half-buried Alien Metallic Fragment
—humming faintly when touched.
6
A bloody message smeared on a 
windshield: “DON’T GO INSIDE.”
Tension Impact:

Searching the area noisily: +1d4 Tension

Triggering a car alarm: +2d6 Tension

Using a firearm: +1d6 Tension

Starting a fire (gas spill or flare distraction): 
+1d6 Tension

Opening the semi-truck trailer: Major risk—
triggers enemy encounter
Enemy Encounters (Roll 1d6 
on entry OR when noise is 
made)
d6 Roll Enemy Type
1-2
Shamblers (1d6) – Basic zombies, 
slow but persistent.
3
Trapped Infected (1d4) – Zombies 
emerge from inside cars when 
disturbed.
4
Crawler Swarm (2d4) – Limbless 
undead hidden under vehicles, 
grabbing ankles.
5
Gasbag Zombie (1-2) – Bloated 
corpse explodes in toxic fumes 
when killed.
6
The Thing in the Semi-Truck (See 
below)
Special Encounter: The Thing 
in the Semi-Truck
If players investigate the jackknifed semi-truck, they 
find scattered biohazard crates labeled “Property of 
BioDyne Corporation.” The air smells sickly sweet—a 
rotting corpse slumps over the driver’s seat… but 
isn’t quite dead.
When the players enter the truck trailer, they must 
roll a d6:
d6 
Roll
What’s Inside?
1-3
Mutant Brute (Boss-Level Enemy) 
– A heavily mutated experiment 
bursts from containment, its body 
still growing new twisted 
appendages.
4-5
Suspiciously Intact Crates – 
 183 

Exterior Areas
 
Zombie Mall
Contain medical supplies (100 SV 
total), but disturbing them has a 
50% chance of awakening a Bio-
Mutant inside.
6
Survivor (Desperate & 
Malnourished) – He knows 
something about the outbreak but 
is deeply paranoid.
Enemies:
Shamblers (1d6)
AC 8, HP 12, Speed 20 ft
Attack: Bite (1d6 damage, infection chance)
Slow-moving, drawn to noise
Gasbag Zombie (Exploder)

AC 10, HP 15

On death: Explodes in toxic gas cloud (CON 
Save DC 13 or take 1d8 poison damage & 
disadvantage on actions for 1d4 rounds).
Mutant Brute (Truck Encounter)

AC 15, HP 40

Attacks:
o
Flesh Spike (Reach 10ft, 2d6 
damage, grapple)
o
Ground Slam (30ft radius, knocks 
enemies prone)

Resists bullets; weak to fire.
XP & Survival Value (SV) 
Rewards:
Scouting & Securing the Road: 250 SV
Finding Lore Clues (diaries, BioDyne badge, or 
radio signals): +50 SV
Clearing out all threats: +150 SV
Securing a Vehicle (functional car or gas from the 
lot): 100 SV
Escape Opportunities:

Finding a Working Car: 40% chance that a 
vehicle in the lot is still functional (needs gas or 
minor repairs).

Using the Semi-Truck: If the brute is killed, 
players can try to move the truck, clearing a 
better path to escape the area.

Hijacking the Police Cruiser: Found near an 
overturned barrier. Sirens still operational—
could be a distraction or a death trap.
Final Notes:
This Main Road encounter is a high-risk, high-
reward zone—players will be exposed, forced to 
make noise, and must navigate threats carefully. It 
serves as a gateway into the mall, but also a 
reminder that escape isn’t easy—they’re trapped in 
a world that has already fallen.

a world that has already fallen.

sites.name: Service Road
sites.bookText:
Service Road (Back of the 
Mall)
“The asphalt here is cracked and pitted, with weeds 
growing  through  its  jagged  wounds.  Broken 
streetlights  loom  over  the  scene  like  skeletal 
sentinels,  their  shattered  bulbs  swaying  in  the 
occasional gust of wind. Rusting delivery trucks sit 
abandoned, their doors hanging open like yawning 
mouths, revealing crates of long-rotted produce and 
forgotten shipments. The faded yellow exit signs are 
vandalized with deep gouges and strange symbols—
some carved, others painted in a substance too dark 
to be rust. A police cruiser sits half-embedded in a 
crumbling pothole, its flashing lights long dead, but 
the radio inside still crackles with intermittent static, 
as if waiting for someone to listen. A distant moan 
echoes  down  the  service  alley.  Something  is 
watching.”
General Description

Layout: A narrow back-access road looping 
behind the mall, used for employee parking, 
deliveries, and maintenance vehicles.

Key Features:
 184 

Zombie Mall
 
Exterior Areas
o
Abandoned Police Cruiser with 
partially working radio.
o
Vandalized Exit Signs marked with 
weird occult symbols, burn marks, 
and deep scratches.
o
Delivery Trucks with some doors 
forced open, others mysteriously 
locked tight.
o
Dilapidated Service Entrance—a 
metal door half off its hinges, leading 
into the mall’s maintenance 
corridors.
o
Scattered Trash & Burnt Debris, 
evidence of past survivors making a 
last stand—or a desperate escape.
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & Traps (Roll 1d4 on 
entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Slick Oil Spill: A ruptured truck 
tank has leaked motor oil across 
the road. Running or driving here 
requires a DC 14 Dexterity check 
to avoid slipping/spinning out.
2
Torn Chain-Link Fence: A hole in 
the fence leads to a possible 
escape route, but it’s surrounded by 
piled-up corpses. A DC 13 
Perception check reveals that 
some of them… aren’t quite dead. 
(1d4 Crawlers awaken if disturbed.)
3
Cracked Pavement Sinkhole: A 
large pothole near the police 
cruiser is deeper than it looks. 
Stepping too close (DC 12 Dex 
check) causes it to collapse, 
dropping the player into an 
underground maintenance shaft.
4
Lingering Gas Leak: One of the 
trucks still has a slow natural gas 
leak. Any gunfire or open flame 
nearby has a 20% chance of 
causing an explosion (3d6 fire 
damage in 15ft radius).
Interactables & Loot
d6 Roll Notable Items
1
Working Police Radio – Still picks 
up faint transmissions. 
Occasionally broadcasts strange 
messages, survivor distress calls, 
or garbled military orders.
2
Shotgun with 2 Shells – Found in 
the police cruiser’s trunk, next to a 
bloodstained uniform.
3
Handcuffed Corpse – A dead 
officer handcuffed to the steering 
wheel. He has a mall security 
keycard (opens one locked door 
inside).
4
Truck Cargo Manifest – A 
clipboard listing a shipment of 
medical supplies to a now-
abandoned mall pharmacy. Could 
lead to a valuable scavenging 
opportunity.
5
Mysterious Scrap of Paper – 
Found near the vandalized signs, it 
reads: “Don’t listen to the numbers. 
The numbers lie.”
6
Hidden Survivor Stash – A small 
lockbox (DC 15 to pick) wedged 
inside a truck tire. Contains 
painkillers (5 SV), a loaded 
revolver (25 SV), and a silver 
crucifix (Lore Item).
Ambiguous Lore
The vandalized exit signs and truck manifests hint at 
different theories about the apocalypse:
d4 Roll Lore Clue
 185 

Exterior Areas
 
Zombie Mall
1
The Signs Are Warnings: The 
scratches are hastily made 
warnings, not vandalism. Some 
contain messages in Latin 
referring to “the Sixth Seal” and 
“ascending beasts.”
2
The Police Knew Something: The 
dead officer’s notepad mentions 
an emergency lockdown order 
but no explanation why. His last 
written words: “Containment 
breach. No exit.”
3
Numbers Station Broadcasts: 
The police radio occasionally 
picks up a repeating number 
sequence, eerily similar to ones 
found inside the mall’s electronics 
store.
4
Truck Manifest Oddity: One truck 
manifest is labeled “SPECIAL 
DELIVERY - DO NOT OPEN” but 
its contents aren’t listed 
anywhere. The matching truck is 
still locked shut.

SV Reward

threats)



Tension)

Making Noise Near the Locked Truck (+2d6 
Tension)

Triggering a Hazard (Explosion, Sinkhole, 
etc.) (+2d8 Tension)

Using the Police Radio at the Wrong Time 
(Risk of Attracting Military Remnant or 
Cultists) (+1d6 Tension)
Potential Enemies
d6 Roll Enemy Encounter
1-2
Shamblers (1d6) – Slow-moving 
but numerous zombies, some 
trapped in vehicles.
3
Crawlers (1d4) – Lying hidden 
among the trash and dead bodies.
4
Infected Cop – A former officer, 
faster than normal zombies, still 
wearing a ballistic vest (AC 
bonus).
5
Strange Cultist (Human, Alive) – 
A lone malnourished survivor, 
muttering about “The Black 
Signal.”
6
Truck Horror – The locked 
delivery truck contains 
something alive. If opened, roll 
1d6:

1-3: Just a pile of rotting meat and flies.

4-5: A mutated zombie with extra limbs (AC 
14, 2 Attacks, 2d6 damage).

6: An emaciated but still-living survivor, 
chained inside. He doesn’t remember how 
long he’s been there…



sites.name: Railroad Tracks
sites.bookText:
Railroad Tracks (Near 
Back Lot)
“The cracked pavement gives way to rusted rails and 
overgrown  weeds,  the  skeletal  remains  of  an 
abandoned freight train stretching across the back lot 
like a forgotten corpse. Graffiti covers the boxcars—
some crude, some cryptic, some disturbingly fresh. 
Several doors hang open, their contents long since 
ransacked,  but  one  car  remains  sealed  tight  with 
heavy-duty locks. A strong metallic scent lingers in 
the  air,  mingling  with  the  scent  of  old  oil  and  
something…  rotten.  The  sound  of  wind  whistling 
through  broken  train  windows  is  occasionally 
interrupted by a faint  thump from inside the locked 
car. Something—or someone—is still in there.”
Description

Layout: The derailed freight train consists of 
six boxcars in varying states of decay. Some 
are rusted shut, others are open and looted, 
while one remains mysteriously sealed. 
Tracks extend in both directions, vanishing into 
the tree line beyond the mall.

Threats: 1d4 Shamblers lurk inside and 
around the train, hiding under debris or wedged 
between cargo. Something large pounds 
against the inside of the locked car.

Hazards: The unstable train cars creak 
dangerously when climbed on. Some have 
rotting wooden floors, requiring Dexterity 
checks to avoid falling through. A few corpse 
pits nearby suggest prior looter activity—some 
of them might still move.
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards (Roll 1d4 on Entry)
d4 Roll Hazard
1
Collapsing Car – One boxcar is 
unstable. Dexterity DC 15 or fall 
through rusted floor (2d6 damage).
2
Dead Power Line – A snapped 
electrical line dangles from a pole, 
crackling ominously. Moving past 
requires Dexterity DC 14, failure 
results in 1d8 shock damage.
3
Toxic Spill – A breached tanker 
nearby has leaked corrosive 
chemicals. Prolonged exposure 
inflicts 1d4 poison damage per 
round.
4
Rotting Cargo – Opening a 
random boxcar unleashes a 
swarm of rats (see enemy stat 
block).
Interactables & Loot
d6 
Roll
Notable Items
1
Crowbar – Perfect for prying open 
doors or as a melee weapon (1d6 
damage, +2 to force locks).
2
Half-Burned Map – Old freight 
manifest with handwritten notes 
about “classified cargo.” (Lore 
clue)
 187 

Exterior Areas
 
Zombie Mall
3
Bolt Cutters – Heavy-duty, can cut 
chains, fences, or locks. Worth 25 
SV if secured.
4
Ammo Cache – Hidden in a false 
compartment: 1d12 handgun 
bullets and one shotgun shell.
5
Railway Worker’s Satchel – 
Contains a keyring, cigarettes, and 
a bloodstained ID badge 
(Ambiguous Lore).
6
Survivor’s Skeleton – Crushed 
beneath a cargo container. Holds 
a revolver (3 rounds left) and a 
handwritten diary entry.
Ambiguous Lore
Scattered throughout the area are cryptic clues hinting 
at the multiple causes of the apocalypse. Survivors 
may piece together different explanations:
d4 
Roll
Ambiguous Clue
1
Corporate Shipping Manifest – A 
ledger references a “BIO-6 Mutagen 
Sample” scheduled for delivery one 
week before the outbreak.
2
Occult Symbols on Boxcar Walls 
– A ritualistic script is scrawled in 
blood, referencing “the vessel has 
been sealed” and “the sacrifice 
awaits.”
3
Radio Interference – If players use 
a working radio near the train, a 
distorted transmission warns, “DO 
NOT OPEN THE FINAL CAR.”
4

sites.name: Sewer Entrance
sites.bookText:
Sewer Entrance (Under 
Parking Garage)
“A foul-smelling mist seeps from the grated sewer 
entrance, curling around the cracks in the pavement 
like grasping fingers. The metal grate is slightly ajar, 
as  if  someone—or  something—forced  their  way 
inside. A rusted maintenance ladder descends into 
darkness, where the faint sound of dripping water 
echoes ominously. Spray-painted in erratic, jagged 
letters on the nearby wall are the words: ‘THEY ARE 
BELOW US.’ The letters appear hastily scrawled… 
and smeared with something too dark to be paint.”
General Description

Layout: Located beneath the parking garage, 
this sewer entrance leads into the underground 
maintenance tunnels and drainage systems of 
the mall.

Visibility: Nearly pitch black; survivors need 
flashlights or other light sources.

Smell: Overwhelming stench of stagnant 
water, rot, and something metallic… like 
blood.

Water Level: 1-2 feet deep in some areas, 
slowing movement and concealing hidden 
threats.
 189 

Exterior Areas
 
Zombie Mall
Encounter Elements
Environmental Hazards & Traps (Roll 1d6 upon 
entry)
d6 Roll Hazard
1
Collapsing Ladder: The rusted 
ladder breaks under pressure. DEX 
DC 14 or fall 10ft into water (1d6 
bludgeoning damage).
2
Swarm of Sewer Rats: Dozens of 
starving rats scatter from the 
darkness, biting anyone with food 
on them (1d4 damage per round 
unless frightened away).
3
BioDyne Chemical Spill: The 
water here glows faintly green. 
Standing in it for more than 3 
rounds requires a CON save (DC 
13) to resist mild radiation sickness.
4
Unstable Walkway: A narrow 
ledge along the wall crumbles 
under weight. DEX DC 12 or fall 
into the deeper sewage channel.
5
Echoing Moans: Something 
deeper in the tunnels lets out an 
inhuman wail. Increase Tension 
by +1d6.
6
Hidden Tripwire: A survivor once 
tried to set up a trap. DEX DC 15 
to notice, or a rusted pipe 
collapses, making a loud noise 
(+1d4 Tension).
Interactables & Loot (Roll 1d6 
per thorough search attempt)
d6 
Roll
Notable Items
1
Waterlogged Backpack: Contains a 
rusty machete (1d8, slightly weaker 
than a new one) and 1d4 rations.
2
Maintenance Keycard: Unlocks a 
secure utility door in the mall, 
leading to an alternative safe route 
or hidden supply cache.
3
BioDyne Research Log: A half-
destroyed waterproof clipboard with 
notes about an “anomalous 
presence detected in subterranean 
tunnels.”
4
Severed Hand (Clutching a 
Flashlight): Still functional; adds 
light source, but was this person 
attacked… or transforming?
5
Old Toolbox: Contains pliers, duct 
tape, a multi-tool (15 SV), and a 
makeshift pry bar (1d6 weapon).
6
Strange Symbol Etched Into The 
Wall: (See Ambiguous Lore)
Ambiguous Lore: (Roll 1d4 for 
discovery—each hint points to 
a different cause of the 
apocalypse.)
d4 
Roll
Ambiguous Clue
1
A crumpled military report warns of 
“unexplained seismic activity in the 
underground tunnel network.”
2
A torn cultist robe snagged on a 
drainpipe, along with an unreadable 
book of water-damaged rituals.
3
A recording on a broken walkie-
talkie—a scientist whispering 
frantically: “It wasn’t a virus. We 
disturbed something ancient—it’s 
awake now.”
4
A mural painted in blood depicts 
an island in the distance, with 
shadowy tendrils reaching from 
beneath the waves.
 190 

Zombie Mall
 
Exterior Areas
Potential Enemies (Roll 1d6 
upon exploration—can stack 
with hazards!)
d6 Roll Enemy Encounter
1-2
Shamblers (1d4) – Waterlogged 
zombies, slower but harder to kill 
(resistant to piercing).
3
Crawlers (2-3) – Infected dragging 
themselves through the sewage, 
hidden beneath the water.
4
Mutated Sewer Rat Swarm – 
Infested with bio-experiments, 
these oversized rodents spread 
disease.
5
“The Thing Below” – A stalking 
entity, watching survivors from just 
out of sight. They never see it 
clearly, but the feeling of being 
followed is undeniable.
6
Cultist Remnant (Insane 
Survivor) – A lone man, half-
mad, muttering about “the great 
awakening” while wielding a 
rusty pipe (1d6). Can be 
reasoned with or fought.
Monster Stat Blocks
Shamblers (Waterlogged)

HP: 15

AC: 11

Attack: Slam (1d6) or Bite (1d8, infection 
chance)

Special: Resistant to piercing damage, 
immune to drowning.
Mutated Sewer Rats (Swarm)
HP: 10 (Swarm disperses if below 5 HP)
AC: 12
Bites: 1d4 per round
Special: Spread disease (CON save DC 12 or take 1d4 
Constitution damage over 24 hours).
The Thing Below (??? – Optional Encounter)

HP: Unknown (Cannot be fought directly)

Effect: Every few minutes, survivors feel 
watched. If they linger too long, something 
drags one of them into the darkness (INT 
save DC 15 to resist).
XP & Survival Value (SV)
Action or Loot 
Secured
SV Reward
Fully securing the 
sewer entrance
200 SV
Discovering the 
Maintenance Keycard
50 SV
Recovering BioDyne 
Research Notes
75 SV
Finding and 
deciphering the 
Ambiguous Lore 
clues
50 SV per clue
Successfully 
navigating without 
triggering hazards
+1 XP per survivor
Tension Impact
Action
Tension Increase
Loud noises (falling 
pipes, crumbling 
ledges, tripwires)
+1d6
Fighting zombies in 
tight corridors
+1d4 per round of 
combat
Discovering “The 
Thing Below”
+2d6 instantly
Lighting up the 
tunnels (disturbing 
unseen things)
+1d4 per room lit
 191 

Exterior Areas
 
Zombie Mall
Escape & Resolution

Survivors can return to the mall via 
maintenance tunnels if they restore power 
(requires Smart Survivor roll, DC 14).

If The Thing Below reaches its “prey 
threshold,” the last person in the group goes 
missing unless rescued quickly.

The cultist may guide survivors deeper 
underground… but at what cost?
 192 

Zombie Mall
